Missions_en|677634886427729922:
My Lord, to our great regret, the King has discovered how we manage to keep the price of beer so low. Truth be told, I didn’t expect anyone to notice the presence of illegal migrants working on our hop farms.

I’d be happy to tell you that in this situation we could get away with a fine or community service... Unfortunately, that’s not the case.

From now on, we can expect the arrival of the Royal “deportation forces” at any moment. Their mission is to deport people to the afterlife — both the migrants and those involved in the so-called “exploitation of their labor.”
Missions_en|677634886431924224:
My Lord, I brought some news. It involves a slight adjustment to the forecast for the course of our small-scale military conflict, from “negative” to “extremely negative”. For us, that is.

The factor influencing the forecast was <#ABA291>Terminator machines, or more precisely, the fact that the Royal deportation forces have established production of them nearby.

I believe we’ll see these machines in action pretty soon. And likely, the longer it goes, the more demonstrations of the capabilities of this unique siege weapon we’ll witness.

Missions_en|540470052653481991: A version of Infinite Regime that replicates Sibylla the Carefree's eastward expansion. In 1409, Brendan “Bucklan” of Lisvay refused to recognize Samreignia's independence. In 1410, when his line of defense fell, he abruptly changed his mind. Missions_en|540470052653481992:
My Lord, don't worry. All the battles we'll be experiencing in the coming days are merely historical reenactments of the famous Battle of Lizway in 1409.

But there is a small nuance: you and I represent the losing side, so.... Well, let's not get ahead of ourselves.

As true history buffs, we must be true to the spirit of the defenders of Lizway. And that means holding out to the last man.
Missions_en|540470052657676288:
My Lord, we are about to reenact the turning point of the Battle for Lizway. Back in 1409, Sibyl the Carefree launched an innovative weapon, later named as Terminator Machine by Ferdinand II.

A powerful strike of these fearsome siege weapons spectacularly shattered the first, then the second, and then the last line of defense of Count Brendan.

Those who play for the Samreignia army today have just moved some Terminator Machines on us. But I think we should go further in our reenactment and check out what would have happened if Lizway defense survived that fateful day.
Missions_en|122379976808706056: The version of the endless mode in which you resist the aggression of a royal army. Enemy attacks will be fierce, powerful, but not too frequent. Therefore, your Resistance still stands a chance, and the difficulty of the version is rated as moderate.

You've just survived the war yet the plague didn't show up. But don't get too excited. This time, on its three tails, the comet has brought you something far worse...
Missions_en|122379976808706050: The version of the endless mode in which you will face zombies.
Missions_en|123445298189938688: My Lord, the decision to wait out the battle of the Ten Kingdoms behind the castle walls was the right one. Our enemies succeeded in killing each other off. But before they did, they plundered and covered our lands with corpses. Perhaps we should bury the dead...
Missions_en|123444906056069120: My Lord, no evil omens for today. But it seems too quiet to me. Feels like calm before the storm. Makes me nervous. I would strengthen the guards just in case.
Missions_en|123444906077040640: My Lord, bad omens. Last night weevils devoured all the grapevines. Six horses went wild and ran away from your stables and a stablemate was poisoned to death by a plum brandy. Something's coming this night. We must strengthen the watch.
Missions_en|123444906077040641: My Lord! The fallen soldiers rise from the dead! To arms!
Missions_en|123444906077040642: My lord, another stable man got poisoned today by a plum brandy. Again, horses ran away. In fact, even cows had tar instead of milk. It looks like tonight the dead will rise again.
Missions_en|123444906077040643: My Lord, I took the liberty of sending messengers for help to all the neighbouring nine kingdoms. The bad omens tonight are terrifying to the imagination, so I won't share them. I would say this night arms should be given to all who can hold them.
Missions_en|122379976808706052: My Lord, the messengers have returned. There is no one alive but us. No one will come to help. Dead from all the neighbouring lands are after us.

Missions_en|125957164808122368: The version of the endless mode designed for those who have mastered the basics of the game and are not afraid of challenges.
Missions_en|125957164808122372: My Lord, when we arrived to these lands, at first I was afraid. In fact, I was petrified at the prospect of being lynched by a mob of angry peasants. But considering their numbers, I believe we may contain the pressure. Chances are we can hold on for a while at least. Hopefully we'll survive long enough to die old.
Missions_en|192945551301259264: Holy guacamole! They cloned Scott the Bloody! Bastards!
Missions_en|125957164808122371: Stay alive for as long as you can!
Missions_en|331795643298201602:
The endless mode version of high difficulty. From the very beginning, you are surrounded by the combined forces of the Rebels, the Royal Army, and the Undead. You will be invaded from all sides, each attacking wave may contain units from different factions in any proportions and combinations.

P.S. Not all the attacks will be displayed on the mini-map.
Missions_en|331795643298201600: The endless mode version of high difficulty. From the very beginning, you are surrounded by the combined forces of the Rebels, the Royal Army, and the Undead.
Missions_en|331795643298201604:
My Lord, HELP! I mean, My Lord, we are in a desperate situation! Our enemies had gathered together and decided to attack us with their combined armies.

They have already succeeded in moving troops here. We are surrounded! The enemy has severe superiority in numbers, so we are going to be under constant pressure.

Not to mention the approaching of the main forces. By the way, they are already here...
Missions_en|331795643298201605:
My lord, there is a severe shortage of eagle-eyed scouts at the front.

The enemy in his turn is sneaky and vicious. He has deceptive maneuvers and stealthy movements in his toolbox.

I can't guarantee that you'll be warned about the upcoming assault in time. The enemy may strike unexpectedly, from any direction! I suggest we take a circular defense.
Missions_en|331795643298201606:
My lord, I must admit It's a pleasant surprise that we're still alive. However, our success in survival doesn't look to last long, though.

We've learned that the enemies have gathered their forces into a fist, or should I say multiple fists. They will launch a series of coordinated attacks from different directions, with several armies at once.
Missions_en|331795643298201607:
Troubling news, My Lord!

Looks like the enemy reinforcements will make it here before the current attack fizzles out.
Missions_en|331795643298201608:
My lord, bad news has become something of a habit lately, so instead of fooling around around, I'll tell this one straight.

The Undead Overlord has given the green light for the use of Nightmare Generals in action. I can't tell exactly how many will arrive or even when they'll be here. But we're absolutely doomed to face them.

In case you haven't encountered Nightmare General before, let me explain: one General is worth more than a dozen of our troops...
Missions_en|331795643298201609: My Lord, the iron footsteps of Nightmare Generals are echoing throughout the land. They are coming! Soon they will enter the battlefield.
Missions_en|331795643298201603: Stay alive for as long as you can!
Missions_en|405340632577323010: The version of the endless mode of low difficulty. There are enough resources on the map to fight the Undead. Enemies will come in large numbers, but the cliffs will help you defend against them due to narrow passages. Among the enemies, there are Magisters of Necromancy, who can resurrect your fallen warriors. And these warriors, having come back to life, will fight against you.
Missions_en|405340632577323008: The version of the endless mode of low difficulty. For those who want to fight the Undead without too much stress.
Missions_en|405340632577323012:
My Lord, my brilliant idea for a vacation on the beautiful coast turned out to be not so brilliant.

These lands belong to the Undead, and they're not particularly friendly. We're lucky they can't swim, which makes us unlikely to be attacked from the sea.

Our vigilant scouts say that enemy ranks have Magisters of Necromancy. Realistically, it means that any of our untimely departed soldiers may switch sides.
Missions_en|405340632577323011: Stay alive for as long as you can!
Missions_en|499625033919217679: This version of the endless mode is extra challenging. You are to command the Undead, and they are a very specific faction. The game experience will be a bit different from what you're used to if you haven't experienced the faction in the story campaign.
Missions_en|499625033927606272: This version of the endless mode is designed for those who want to fight for the Undead. Your opponent will be the Royal Army.
Missions_en|499625033927606275:
My lord, just a reminder, I'm the Ninth Twilight Lord, your advisor, band producer, mentor, and a simply a great guy.

Sorry to say that, but I let you down a little bit this time. And we're in trouble. Well, you're in trouble.

You see, we were supposed to invade Samreignia and turn all the living into undead. But I made a slight mistake with the mission key, and instead of the Challenge Mode, you and I ended up in the Endless Mode. Which means you're gonna die sooner or later. My condolences.
Missions_en|499625033919217680: Exterminate all living things for as long as you can
Missions_en|603980831489466368: This version of the endless mode is highly challenging. You angered the Twilight Overlord by refusing to perform his favorite song, “Forever Young, I want to be forever dead,” at the Christmas party. To punish you, he sent you to a world where Sarranga has tamed the Heffalumps. And they still hate your music...
Missions_en|603980831518826497: This version of the endless mode is designed for those who want to fight for the Undead. This time, your opponents are the Sarranga tribe and Heffalumps.
Missions_en|603980831523020801:
My Lord, yesterday you refused the Ninth Twilight Overlord's request, and you didn't do it with respect. For this, he teleported us to certain death.

The longer we can avoid this unpleasant lot, the higher the chance that he'll calm down and return us to the non-living later.

However, avoiding death is not going to be easy. Firstly, we are sitting ducks here, with almost no resources nearby. Secondly, the lack of mountains leaves us without natural protection. And finally, in this world, Sarranga have tamed the Heffalumps. So, we'll have to deal with both of them, and probably at the same time.
Missions_en|603980831518826496: Exterminate all living things for as long as you can
Missions_en|407610822157512704:
My Lord! Our watchful scouts have missed the whole thing!

The enemy has secretly sent several sabotage groups to the front. They are attacking us now, using the surprise factor.

And, My Lord, unfortunately I can't guarantee that our scouts won't miss something like this again.
Missions_en|414457642640846848: You allowed a small group of rebellious peasants to pass freely to the Townhall and received them as parliamentarians. They complained about their hard lives and asked for help. You can stay on the King's side or join the rebels.
Missions_en|414457642670206976: Instead of fighting the locals, you decided to negotiate. Princess Shankhar offers you an alliance with Sarranga tribe. This is one of those moments when you can choose which side to take.
Missions_en|414457642670206977: Turns out the Undead have some kind of interest in you. An entity claiming to be the Ninth Twilight Lord is offering you to die... temporarily. This is the last moment in the game when you can choose which faction to support.
Missions_en|743840608260: April 28, 1491. The fire of peasant rebellion suddenly broke out in my fief. The mob wants me, my family, and anyone else who is in any way connected with royalty dead. A mob of armed peasants is heading for my castle, ravaging everything their dirty rakes can reach.
Missions_en|743840608258:
Your grandfather Sir Duncan Ironbrow was a true war hero. In the battle for the independence of Samreignia he chopped 15 Inverland knights and bit off the ear of another. For that Queen Sybil the Carefree granted him a fief and a title of nobility.

The fief had been a poor place even under your grandfather, yet your father left much of it desolated, especially the wine cellar. When he broke his neck while hunting deer, your reign began.

Being young you wanted to become famous, but after 16 years of peaceful life in the middle of nowhere you left those dreams behind. After all, unlike many, you already have a glorious bloodline and a castle...
Missions_en|26013880173928448: My Lord, for the first time in history your castle will be stormed. And if we are to tell anyone what it was like, I would advise you to make some steps.
Missions_en|26014028916531200:
We are terribly outnumbered, and a strong line of defense is the key to survival. We need archers on the walls, infantry capable of holding the line, and more war machines.
If we don't have these things by the time the siege comes, My Lord, I fear we will all die, and die a horrible and painful death.
Missions_en|26014140887670784:
My Lord, it appears that our eagle-eyed scouts lack arithmetics basics.
One said attackers are plenty. The second said, "Very many." The third lost count. And the fourth can't count at all...
Missions_en|26014786206507008: My Lord, allow me to introduce you a crowd of unwashed scum who have dared to challenge you.
Missions_en|26015930316169216:
Well, My Lord, apparently, the starving, destitute, and deprived rabble were simply looking for a way to die with dignity.
As befits a wise shepherd, you showed your flock the right direction.
Missions_en|26016063191719936: My Lord, scouts report that rebels from all remaining camps are joining the attacking wave. The enemy is gathering all his forces for a decisive assault.
Missions_en|26016123589697536:
My Lord, the rebellion has entered the phase of a psychic attack. The peasants have decided to throw all their remaining forces at us at once.
Victory is ours if the castle defense will hold.
Missions_en|669183009612619791:
Destroy the buildings marked on the mini-map
(they spawn additional enemies) {0}
Missions_en|11036951310155776: Kill all rebels in the valley, otherwise they will join the final attacking wave
Missions_en|223729699045355520: May 2, 1491. The fire of peasant revolt breaks out in my fief. My subjects suffer poverty and hunger, and Ferdinand II increases the taxes. A knight must stand up for those in distress. I must defy my suzerain and defend the people who have entrusted me with their lives.
Missions_en|223729699045355522:
Your grandfather Sir Duncan Ironbrow was a true war hero. In the battle for the independence of Samreignia he chopped 15 Inverland knights and bit off the ear of another. For that Queen Sybil the Carefree granted him a fief and a title of nobility.

The fief had been a poor place even under your grandfather, yet your father left much of it desolated, especially the wine cellar. When he broke his neck while hunting deer, your reign began.

Being young you wanted to become famous, but after 16 years of peaceful life in the middle of nowhere you left those dreams behind. After all, unlike many, you already have a glorious bloodline and a castle...
Missions_en|367385532827545600:
My Lord, the peasants are under your protection now. They constantly thank Providence for sending them a noble and compassionate guardian. However, humanistic values have yet to spread in Samreignia.

Moreover, royal tax collectors regarded your act of mercy as a betrayal. They have regrouped into His Majesty's punitive forces and seek to seize your castle.
Missions_en|367385532827545601:
My Lord, His Majesty's punitive forces turned out not to be so brave. The former tax collectors are only good at beating and robbing unarmed peasants, and they are completely unprepared for storming castles.

The news of the Resistance's strength is spreading across Samreignia.
Missions_en|367385532827545602:
My Lord, the news of the strengthening of the Resistance has forced the warriors loyal to His Majesty to unite. They have fair reasons to fear that if we mobilize our forces, they will be overwhelmed.

The limited contingent of the Royal Army stationed at field camps in the area is to join the upcoming assault.
Missions_en|367385532827545603: My Lord, the enemy has thrown all forces into the decisive strike. Royal soldiers from all over the land are marching on us. If the castle holds, the Resistance can celebrate its first major victory.
Missions_en|669183009612619792:
Destroy the buildings marked on the mini-map
(they spawn additional enemies) {0}
Missions_en|367385532789796864: Kill all the royal soldiers in the area or they will join the final attack
Missions_en|186833502343114807: May 11, 1492. This is it. Today decides the future of Samreignia and yours too, King Ferdinand the Fat. Fear me, I'm coming. I have Snoot, Shankhar, and my sword. And nothing can stop us.
Missions_en|186833502343114809:
Abberlore's defenses have been breached. Under the furious onslaught of your army, the enemy fled. Some were in terror, some in panic, some scattered, and some ran more or less holding their lines.

After the capital had fallen, the enthusiasm of even the most stubborn loyalists of Ferdinand II faded. You received a letter, in which they asked to show mercy and prudence. And, perhaps some wisdom. After all, the fate of the country and their former suzerain was at stake. They also assured you that they would accept your choice, gritting their teeth in helplessness.

So, there were no enemies left but one. Ferdinand II, in his cowardice, has laid low. To be precise, he locked himself in the basement of the King's Castle. You, along with your most loyal allies, descended into the dungeon to personally accept the surrender and decide what to do with the tyrant...
Missions_en|306435086080651264:
You walked into my trap! While you were out there ravaging Abberlore, slaughtering innocent civilians, I was in the middle of something!

The elite royal guards are all here in the dungeon of my castle. Samreignia's finest. Every one of them can punch through a wall with his fist. They can run three miles in full armor without getting out of breath. And most importantly, they will all lay down their lives for the true king of Samreignia!

Dear Oathbreaker, your card is dealt. Time to die.
Missions_en|306435086101622785:
I heard someone fighting. Are you still alive in there? What, you're not even hurt? How's that possible?!

And that's what they call "elite" these days? All they can do is hammer nails with their heads. It's true what they say, if you want to do something right, do it yourself.

Well, I'm not doing it myself, of course. I've got some very reliable performers for the occasion. Sir Dwayne and Sir Chuck. Fewer brains than a chicken, but they're true beasts in battle. You'll never pass through them.
Missions_en|306435086101622788:
Sir Dwayne? Sir Chuck? You two don't look well. Great Providence, you killed them!

Well, I have no other options, I guess. I surrender to your mercy.
Missions_en|306435086101622789: Are you out of your mind? That money isn't even my money. It's a prepayment for a Gorgoth horse. It was supposed to be picked up at 4:00 tomorrow. What am I gonna tell the Gorgoth ambassador? Keep in mind that you're driving this country into a debt crisis.
Missions_en|306435086101622790:
You're one of them, aren't you? Didn't you swear allegiance to Mary of Inverland by any chance?

Because if you did, I'm going to upset you. I know her well. Traitors to the crown - any crown - don't stay with her. I had a Master of Spies once. He crossed the border and betrayed a state secret. So she honored him for a week and kept him at court.

Then, a month later, he poisoned himself with cherry wine. The official story is that the pit released poison. But it's strange when everyone drinks wine and only one of them is poisoned to death. I'd think about it if I were you.
Missions_en|306435086101622791: "My Lord", Snoot, and Shankhar must stay alive
Missions_en|223729699057938445: May 11, 1492. This is it. Today decides the future of Samreignia and yours too, King Ferdinand the Fat. Fear me, I'm coming. Perhaps, I have only Snoot and my sword, but you are going down. Now.
Missions_en|223729699057938447:
Abberlore's defenses have been breached. The Resistance forces have broken into the city and surrounded the King's Castle. With a handful of his last loyalists, the despicable usurper Ferdinand II has taken refuge in the dungeons.

You and your loyal servant Snoot fearlessly descended into the enemy's lair to end the war.

As triumphant and Leader of the Resistance, you were now to decide the fate of a tyrant who had spent years drinking the blood of the honest people of Samreignia...
Missions_en|391585845906092032:
You sneaky viper! A ravager! A looter and oath-breaker! Curse the day my illustrious grandmother knighted your grandfather.

Damn you and your whole bloody family! I've long wanted to test my elite guardsmen. It's taken a lot of money to train them, but I've never had a chance to see them in action.

So we'll find out if they were really trained, or if the nobles have again squandered the state funds, and gave me rednecks in polished armor.
Missions_en|391585845952229376:
Jokes aside. You've crossed every possible line.

I'm going to take you personally! Not personally, of course. I haven't picked up a sword in 15 years.

Sir Dwayne and Sir Chuck will be acting on my behalf. They'll explain to you in simple language why you can't mess with the king's authority.
Missions_en|391585845956423680:
Sir Dwayne? Sir Chuck? You two don't look well. Great Providence, you killed them!

Well, I have no other options, I guess. I surrender to your mercy.
Missions_en|391585845956423681: Are you out of your mind? That money isn't even my money. It's a prepayment for a Gorgoth horse. It was supposed to be picked up at 4:00 tomorrow. What am I gonna tell the Gorgoth ambassador? Keep in mind that you're driving this country into a debt crisis.
Missions_en|391585845956423682:
I had a thought recently. It's a very wise and very human thought. You seem like a serious man.

So why don't we two serious men sit down at the negotiating table, huh? We'll discuss possible solutions to our delicate situation. I'll take your title from you, pay you a third of the treasury, give you a ship. You can take your men, your family, whoever you want. And you can sail off to the other side of the world. I won't even come after you. Well, at least not immediately.
Missions_en|391585845956423683: "My Lord" and Snoot must stay alive
Missions_en|223729699057938505: The 220th day of the year 100500 by the Undead reckoning. Heya, Ferdy (the second one)! Ready or not, here I come! Let's party hard!
Missions_en|223729699057938507:
Abberlore has fallen at your feet. Well, almost. King Ferdinand II, with few survivors, has locked himself in the dungeon of his castle, hoping in vain to survive the bloody tide that you and your undead companions have unleashed upon Samreignia.

Lords in Black descended into the dungeon in full force, ready to destroy the last barrier separating you from the greatest show of your career.

With the King gone, you will rid Samreignia of the power of mortals forever. And nothing will stop you from declaring your former homeland the land of the dead...
Missions_en|445906805903437851:
For real? The King of Samreignia is hiding in a dungeon from a bunch of fancy-dressed and powdered troubadours?

I was wondering who was so bold to storm the capital of Samreignia. Now I see. A band of crazy musicians with beginner's luck.

Well, your luck's running out, boys. It's a good thing you're already wearing black. You'll look great in your coffins after my elite guards slaughter you one after another.
Missions_en|445906805903437852:
You're surprisingly perky for simple troubadours. Look, maybe there was a misunderstanding. An unpleasant diplomatic incident, so to speak.

If so, and you're guests from another country, as my foolish advisors have been telling me, then... I sincerely apologize. I didn't recognize you in the make-up. My mistake.

Maybe we forget the whole thing, huh? Both sides overreacted. We'll open an embassy for you, right across the street from my Castle. How about we do some business, establish a cultural exchange, eh?
Missions_en|445906805903437853:
I think I've underestimated your artistic passion a bit. I don't know how, but you broke through my guardsmen.

However, my miserable friends, now you will face Sir Dwayne and Sir Chuck. Your grim stage image won't scare them a bit.

So, if you care about life, run while you still can.
Missions_en|445906805903437854:
Sir Dwayne? Sir Chuck? You two don't look well. Great Providence, you killed them!

Oh, my poor mother! I'm too young to die! Mercy!
Missions_en|436816631269535751: Lords in Black must survive (except for Virtuoso ghoul)
Missions_en|743840608265: May 4, 1491. Thousands of peasants from all over the country flock to the banners of one Scott the Bloody. My uncle's castle is the last barrier to his army reaching the capital. King Ferdinand II the Fat ordered me to stop the renegade at any cost.
Missions_en|743840608264: Between rock and a hard place
Missions_en|743840608263:
Hiding behind the noblest impulse to save your fellow man, you ran away from the endless troubles at home and rushed to help your uncle.

No one met you at the gate. And your uncle's castle looked as if a pair, or even two pairs, of dragons have been mating on its roof.

You were just about to flee when it turned out you didn't have enough provisions for the return voyage. So you ended up going up to Lord Penderaine's chambers...
Missions_en|743840608262: Between a rock and a hard place
Missions_en|85851046940712960:
A henchman of the criminal regime of the tyrant! A poisonous head of a hydra who knows no satiety, I'll smoke you out of your stinking lair!
You cannot hide from the people's wrath or escape my vengeance!
Missions_en|85851046961684480: Just about time to face your death. To be slaughtered by the hand of the destiny, to be mocked by the voice of the poor people of Samreignia, to be drowned in the sands of time for forever!
Missions_en|85851046961684481: I, the future king of Samreignia, the one who broke the chains of poverty promise you: tomorrow vultures will peck at your headless body hanging from Penderaine's townhall.
Missions_en|743844802562: My lord, our brave scouts are reporting the approach of the enemy vanguard. If these pathetic fools decide to storm, we will slaughter them all without loss.
Missions_en|743844802564:
I'm sure you'll be just fine without me, My Lord!
As the chronicler of the descendant of Duncan Ironbrow, I must retire to safety, away from stray arrows, to tell of your deeds later.
Missions_en|743844802566:
Congratulations, you donkey! The "army" you've just defeated was made up of peasants loyal to the crown, fleeing from my justice.
Write your will, for it is I, the future King Scott I of Samreignia, who will come after you.
Missions_en|35046685461651456:
The spineless lackey of the oppressor of the fair citizens of Samreignia.
Behold, my penal battalion! Frankly, I care little for the outcome of the battle, for I wish a painful death for you and that scum.
Missions_en|35047100802605056:
You fat boar! The high walls of Penderaine won't shelter you!
Tomorrow your beheaded body will hang from the townhall and I will ascend to the throne!
Time to pay the bills. Here come my main forces. And they will be accompanied by ALL the freedom fighters from all the camps in the valley.
Missions_en|35047503250268160:
Did you hear the crows croaking your name in the night? This is the bloody harvest approaching.
This is I'm marching to take your soul. You, a pitiful snail, shall not stop
the rightful King Scott I.
Missions_en|35047831311949824: How did I end up in touch with this pathetic rabble? No strategy, no tactics. No ethics, no aesthetics. Dying on the battlefield for their liberty, can you believe? As for you, you rotten geek of the degenerate regime - you can go and f... [inaudible muttering]
Missions_en|669183009616814080: Have Lumbermills of any level working simultaneously {0}:
Missions_en|669183009616814082: Have Stone mines of any level working simultaneously {0}:
Missions_en|669183009616814084: Hire Catapults at the Engineer Guild {0}:
Missions_en|101279697967362048: Kill all enemies in the area, otherwise they will join the final attacking wave
Missions_en|83226194421424128: 14 May 1491. All is lost. For the second week we're retreating. Supplies are running low. The King's army is chasing us all over Samreignia. We have no choice but to find a stronghold and prepare for a siege.
Missions_en|83226194421424130:
You gave Scott the Bloody your best men and let his people pass safely to march on the Capital. The rebel leader gave you his word that he would be on the throne within a week and that he would thank you royally. But before the embers could cool, Scott returned with a badly shattered army and eyes wide with terror.

The King knew that you had defected, and a whole army was on its way to Penderaine to put an end to the unrest.

As a traitor to your country, with a hefty bounty on your head, you were forced to flee south with Scott's remaining forces.
Missions_en|743840608269:
Scott the Bloody and his men have entrusted their lives to you! Only you can save the cause of overthrowing the tyranny.
Royal forces are almost here. Command, my Lord.
Missions_en|743840608271:
And the vile usurper of power calls this an attack? Pfha!
A bunch of miserable imbeciles in the service of the exploiter of the honest citizens of Samreignia shall never break our will to be free!
Missions_en|743844802560:
My brother in arms! Another pack of jackals from the guard wants to feast on the tortured flesh of the oppressed!
But they do not realize that our strength is in the truth! Our cause is just, and my punishing sword longs to sow death!
Missions_en|122382552480460803:
Brother in arms, justice prevails!
Hear the sweet sound of breaking the spines of tyranny's minions? Nothing pleases the eye like a battlefield fertilised with the foul blood of a king's soldiers!
Missions_en|85851046961684483:
Brother in arms, the triumph is nigh! While I am with you, not a thousand or ten thousand of these filthy dogs of despotism can stop us!
Let us slaughter every last henchman of Ferdinand's criminal power!
Missions_en|122382552484655104:
I see the lackeys of the arrogant overlord, who have been afraid to stick their noses any farther than the campfire, are preparing to participate in the final attack!
Let them come! There's enough room for all of them under the ground!
Missions_en|669183009616814081: Have Lumbermills of any level working simultaneously {0}:
Missions_en|669183009616814083: Have Stone mines of any level working simultaneously {0}:
Missions_en|669183009616814085: Hire Catapults at the Engineer Guild {0}:
Missions_en|122382552480460802: Kill all enemies in the area, otherwise they will join the final attacking wave
Missions_en|223729699045355525: May 27, 1491. The King posted patrols along the route of our little army. Last night Scott announced to his men that we wouldn't reach the Resistance fleet without heavy fighting. This morning, most of the rebels deserted. Yes, the Resistance Fleet is waiting off the shore, but there's still a long way to go.
Missions_en|223729699045355527:
Having defeated the royal patrol, you hurriedly packed up your belongings to continue your journey to the shores of the Halimatyan Sea.

It became clear that the portrait of your heroic ancestor Duncan Ironbrow would not fit in your bags. And since there were no other ideas, you decided to hang a Resistance flag in its place in the future. Maybe it's not painted so well, but it's compact.

"We need such ideological companions, ready to deny the past and...", - after a couple of days of travel Scott praised you and suddenly stopped talking because you reached the road to Rothglen. On that road, all sorts of things happen. Unpleasant things mostly...
Missions_en|368408470884298752:
Brother in arms, we are outnumbered, but we must not lose heart. Later, when the flag of the Resistance is flying over Abberlore, the cowards who abandoned our camp will regret failing their True King in his hour of need.

But you and I alone are worth a whole army! The minions of the vile usurper Ferdinand the Fat will not stop us from reaching the Resistance Fleet!
Missions_en|368408470888493056:
Brother in arms! Do you hear the seagulls' cries? Can you feel the salty breeze of the Halimatyan Sea? I do.

Only a couple hundred feet for you and me, but what a giant step for the Resistance! We'll have a fleet in no time!
Missions_en|223729699053744128: Take your squad to the destination point
Missions_en|444572029862916096: May 17, 1491. The damned guardsmen sneakily attacked me on my way to Rothglen. Luckily, there was an abandoned Inverland post nearby, left over from the War of Independence, where I took refuge. There's nowhere to go for help. No one knows I'm here. I'll have to fight back.
Missions_en|444572029862916098:
When you got the news that the main forces of the Royal Army were moving on you, you immediately fell into a stupor. But not for long, because you had to run for your life.

You realized that the Samreignian roads were not safe in the midst of popular unrest a bit late. Namely, at the very moment your party was attacked.

With a small detachment, you managed to elude the pursuit and get to some abandoned fortress, which is not even marked on the map. Scott's assessment of the situation was a little different, however. "This is your opportunity to shine, brother-in-arms. Now you will learn what it means to be a true fighter against the regime," he said...
Missions_en|444572029862916099: Repulse all the attacks of the Royal army
Missions_en|186833502343114752: May 20, 1491. Before leaving for Rothglen, where I am to be provided with ships for the expedition beyond the Halimatyan Sea, King Ferdinand II has arranged a military exercise for me. In order to prove that I am a talented commander, I will fight with the Royal Army, under conditions most possible to real combat.
Missions_en|186833502343114754:
After a few days of good bouncing on the Samreignian roads, you finally arrived at the capital, the glorious city of Abberlore.

Stumbling after the tiresome journey (and because of the wine you drank to make the journey less tiresome), you made your way to the Throne Room.

The time was approaching when Ferdinand II would speak to his loyal vassals. Punctuality never was a strong side of His Majesty. After all, kings may enjoy the privilege of being late...
Missions_en|186833502343114755: Repulse all the attacks of the Royal army
Missions_en|186833502343114757: June 1, 1491. One doesn't simply set sail from Rothglen. I've been given no ships. Since the king won't accept my refusal, I have to arrange the expedition myself. Starting with building a fleet.
Missions_en|186833502343114759:
According to the royal decree, Lord Hareheart of Rothglen was supposed to give you three of his best ships. But at the meeting, he explained that his fleet had left urgently for the Gorgoth Empire to bring Ferdinand II his precious stallion.

Local feudal lord promised to provide you with all the possible help he could offer. However, he immediately specified that he could not give you any money or men..

The Rothglenians, known for their hot temper, become completely out of control when they see strangers near their town. In other words, you had to build an expedition fleet dealing with riots at the same time...
Missions_en|232952597001908224:
Welcome to the suburbs of Rothglen, My Lord. I am pleased to inform you that we are absolutely safe after the suppression of Scott the Bloody's rebellion.

However, King Ferdinand II has made clear the importance of your forthcoming expedition.

It therefore seems to me appropriate to begin building ships without any delay.

First of all, we'll need the seashore, which is fortunately near the Townhall. And secondly, the docks.
Missions_en|284373604434292736: My Lord, the scouts brought troubling news: the festival is out of beer. It seems the entire party will now go to your cellar for more. The enemy's onslaught will only grow stronger. The defenses to the south must be urgently reinforced!
Missions_en|232952597052239872:
My Lord, remember me saying that we were safe here? I might have jumped to conclusions a little too quickly, overlooking Rothglen's famous hospitality. The fact is that we started our business here without proper permission of the ordinary Rothglenians, and probably struck a chord in their sensitive souls.
Now they're coming to teach us a lesson. If I were on board I'd start ringing the alarm bell, My Lord.
Missions_en|232952597052239873:
My Lord, we have pacified the troublesome Rothglenites. But something tells me those of them who remain in the city will not be thrilled to hear of the premature deaths of their fellow countrymen.
And to use a navy expression, we should "raise anchor" as soon as possible.
Missions_en|232952597056434176: The wind has changed, My Lord. It's now blowing from the South, and judging by the hoppy air, the festival crowd is on the move!
Missions_en|232952597056434177:
My Lord! Our vigilant scouts who infiltrated Rothglen report a rift among the townsfolk. They can't find who's responsible for the failure of the attacks on us. And now they're trying to settle their differences with a good old-fashioned brawl.
That gives us time to strengthen defenses, boost the settlement's economy, and eventually build ships.
Missions_en|232952597056434178:
My Lord! The Rothglenians no longer seek the guilty amongst them. They blame us for everything now. Even last year's grape crop being eaten by a weevil.
The Rothglenians are on the rampage, My Lord. We must retaliate and leave this bay quickly.
Missions_en|232952597056434179:
My Lord! Your keen-eyed scouts report an annual beer festival south of our settlement. That would be all right, but the Rothglen provocateurs have convinced the crowd that it would be a good idea to clean out your private cellars to make it even more fun. A drunken mob is coming at us.
They're poorly organized, but given the size of the festival, they will constantly attack us from the South.
Missions_en|232952597056434180: My Lord! The Rothglenians are, as they say in our navy, "dead ahead". I'm not familiar with the latest census, but it seems to me that if we continue like that, Rothglen is in for a population crash. Do we really need that kind of tragedy?
Missions_en|232952597056434181:
Congratulations, My Lord. We've built our first ship. Considering how much wood it took, we'd better save it from the wrath of the Rothglenians. Because if it were to be broken, it would be very... unfortunate.
For my part, I remind you that we will need four ships for the expedition.
Missions_en|232952597056434182: My Lord! All the ships have been built and launched. All that remains is to put the troops on board. We can depart, and, as they say in the navy, "Seven feet under the keel."
Missions_en|223729699053744130: June 1, 1491. "The flagship of the Resistance" turned out to be a fishing boat that sank with our leader. The King's army is coming at my heels. There's nowhere to run. I've ordered to build ships that will deliver us to Cutthroat Castle.
Missions_en|223729699053744132:
The leader of the Resistance, True King Scott the First, led the way. He was unusually enthusiastic and kept repeating that the Resistance Fleet was waiting around the turn. It must have been a figure of speech. Because the path the Resistance was traveling had more than one or even two turns.

You had to duck under branches all the time, to cross rivers more than twice (seemed to be the same river, though). In general, the last stage of the journey looked more like an aimless wander through the forest than anything else.

And when hope was about to leave you, a view of the Rothglen coast opened up...
Missions_en|372022625369436162:
My Lord, the loss of the Resistance flagship with its leader aboard is a great tragedy.

But the worst that can happen is if the King's forces capture us. I think the smartest way out is to build ships and sail to Cutthroat Isle, where Scott I said reinforcements would be waiting for us.

Your Townhall, My Lord, is located on the seashore. All that remains is to find a suitable place to build docks.
Missions_en|372022625369436163:
My Lord, if you have a plan to speed up the building of ships, I'd advise you to implement it as soon as possible. Scouts report the vanguard of His Majesty's Second Foot Army is moving towards our position.

This unit is characterized by a hot temper. I believe it will immediately engage the Resistance.

And even if we survive, the vanguard should soon be followed by the others.
Missions_en|372022625369436164:
My Lord, we were extremely fortunate to repel the attack. We benefited from the hot temper of the Second Foot Army, which prevented the soldiers from using sophisticated battle tactics.

However, I believe the commanders of other military units will also attempt the assault. After all, wanting a bounty for your head is a powerful motivator for many.

I would advise you not to push your luck any further and, to use a navy expression, "Raise anchor" as soon as possible.
Missions_en|372022625369436165:
My Lord, our keen scouts have detected the beat of approaching hoofs. After listening carefully, they concluded it was a horse's stomp.

Analyzing the enemy's movements with the map, they assumed that the King had thrown at us Colin Wild's Seventh Cavalry Division, also known as the Invincible.

If that's true, I'd advise strengthening the defenses.
Missions_en|372022625369436166:
My Lord, this is probably not a good time to announce bad news... Still, you should know that the cavalry you defeated is not the Seventh Cavalry Division, but the Fifteenth, commonly known as the Woeful Nags.

As for the Seventh, it will attack us after all, according to intel.

And as I reflect on the possible encounter between the few Resistance soldiers and these honorable cavaliers, the thought occurs to me that perhaps we should triple or even quadruple our shipbuilding efforts to get our moorings in place before they arrive.
Missions_en|372022625369436167: Incredible, My Lord! You beat off an attack of Colin Wild's Seventh Division. I suppose if it's ever re-formed, its middle name, The Invincible, must be changed.
Missions_en|372022625369436168:
Congratulations, My Lord. The new flagship of the Resistance is ready to sail.

Let's do our best to make sure it doesn't share the fate of the previous flagship. We should try to keep it safe from vandalism, very likely by the Samreignia regular army.

In the meantime, we should continue building ships. I daresay four will be enough to honorably bear the name of the Resistance Fleet.
Missions_en|372022625369436169: My Lord! All the ships have been launched. All we have to do is load the troops on board and set sail.
Missions_en|186833502343114762: August ?7?, 1491. Of the four ships, only one made it to shore. First contact with the natives of these strange lands has led to conflict. It seems I have no choice but to fight them, since I can't sail back.
Missions_en|186833502343114761: From the fire into the frying pan
Missions_en|186833502343114764:
You are probably the first traveler from Samreignia, who managed to cross the Halimatyan Sea.

This adventure could be considered an unequivocal and even overwhelming success. Except for one "but": after the shipwreck you had no idea where you were as all navigational tools were broken.

So you sent your faithful servant, Snoot, out for a scouting mission. The task was simple: to see if the land was inhabited, and to locate golden mountains and rivers of emeralds and rubies...
Missions_en|186833502343114763: From the fire into the frying pan
Missions_en|270927413784719360: My Lord, I think I've misjudged the strength of our negotiating position. Why don't we try to avoid bloodshed and take the "non-violent resistance to evil" approach?
Missions_en|270927413809885184: My Lord, bridges are burned. The die is cast. We cannot negotiate with the locals. We will defend ourselves. We'll write in the annals that it was forced self-defense. It is better to leave the negotiations for later. If we have someone to negotiate with.
Missions_en|270927413809885186: My Lord, word from our alert scouts. We learned that Sarranga have decided to change tactics. We can expect attacks not just from outside their settlement.  With luck, the scouts will predict the directions. But firstly they need to learn how to distinguish a real attack from a deceptive maneuver.
Missions_en|270927413809885188: My Lord! Sarranga declared a third-degree threat. We don't know how many degrees there are. And if you'll excuse me, I personally don't have much use for that knowledge. I sincerely advise you to stop waiting for us to be swept away and to strike preemptively. If we attack them, they will not be able to fight us again.
Missions_en|270927413809885190:
My Lord, miraculously, we survived another attack. I will cite the experience of your illustrious ancestor, Duncan Ironbrow. Perhaps this story will give you some thoughts on our current position.
According to eyewitnesses, your grandfather spent a very long time in an ambush during the Battle for the Independence of Samreignia. Before leading his men into battle, he gave a war cry: "We're sitting here like rats in a *&%$hole!"
It should be mentioned that your grandfather, before becoming a knight, was a sailor. And his unorthodox sense of strategy and imaginative thinking paid off.
Missions_en|239398827278053376: Locate and destroy the Heart of the Sarranga Tribe
Missions_en|186833502343114765: Locate and destroy the Sarranga Citadel
Missions_en|223729699053744135: August ? 7 ? 1491. We shipwrecked off Cutthroat Isle. Suddenly, we discovered that Scott the Bloody, our True King, was alive. But that was the end of the good news. Apparently, upon hearing about the defeat of the Resistance, Cutthroats led by Scott's cousin have sided with the King. There's no retreat. We're going to take this fight.
Missions_en|223729699053744134: How do we get to the Cutthroat Castle?
Missions_en|223729699053744137:
Given that you had survived a shipwreck and docked on the shore of Cutthroat Castle (as the drunken acting boatswain had assured you), you decided that you deserved the right to rest.

A few things clouded the situation, though. First of all, resting on a lifeless rocky shore is no fun. Also, you could use something softer than aged cheese and corned beef, but where could you get anything else on a lifeless rocky shore?

You also had to explain to Cutthroats that Scott the First had tragically sunk, and on that occasion, they should accept you as the new Leader of the Resistance. Finally: how, even with a replenished army, to return to Samreignia, since you have no ships...
Missions_en|223729699053744136: How do we get to the Cutthroat Castle?
Missions_en|369852249612857345:
My Lord, some people are approaching. Dressed strangely and speaking a different language. Supposedly they're cutthroats.

And supposedly they remember the arrangement with Scott the Bloody. We don't know if they're willing to help us, though. Perhaps if we let them pass freely, we might be able to come to some agreement with them.
Missions_en|369852249612857346:
My Lord, the linguistic barrier prevents us from understanding the other side of the conflict. It also prevents us from understanding the reasons for it. Or from what's going on here in the first place.

What is clear is that blood has been shed and the war will continue until someone surrenders.

Should we lose, I wouldn't hold out much hope of mercy to the cutthroats, so I suggest you force them to admit defeat.
Missions_en|369852249612857348: My Lord, word from our alert scouts. We learned that enemy changed tactics. We can expect attacks not just from outside their settlement. With luck, the scouts will predict the directions. But firstly they need to learn how to distinguish a real attack from a deceptive maneuver.
Missions_en|369852249617051649:
My Lord! If I have interpreted the enemy's language correctly, those with whom we are at war have declared a third degree of military threat.

This tells us little, for we know nothing what is behind it nor how many degrees of threat are written in the enemy's military doctrine.

Nevertheless, I strongly advise you to counterattack. If we destroy the outpost, the enemy will have no choice but to surrender.
Missions_en|369852249617051651:
My Lord, if you expect to starve out the enemies, I believe that's the wrong tactics.

Based on the way things are going, we will not survive behind the walls. If we do not gain the initiative, our defenses will eventually fail.

I humbly ask you to consider a decisive and devastating counterattack.
Missions_en|223729699053744138: Locate and destroy the Cutthroat Castle
Missions_en|369852249583497216: Locate and destroy the Cutthroats' Headquarters
Missions_en|186833502343114767: September ?8?, 1491. It is a serious offense under Samreignian law to hold a princess as a prisoner. I had hoped that the amount of the ransom would make it possible to overlook the questionable ethics of my act. But more than a month has passed, and the messenger I sent to the natives has not returned. I suppose I have to find another way to replenish the treasury with Sarranga riches.
Missions_en|186833502343114769:
Trying to obtain the Ransom for Princess will make the Tomb Raiders mission unplayable.

After listening to both plan suggestions, you decided to trust your loyal servant Snoot. This time you've worked out every little thing.

A messenger was immediately sent to the nearest Sarranga settlement with ransom demands for the Princess. Specifically, the total weight of the jewels, the deadline for collecting them, and the place where the ransom was to be delivered.

At the said place you built another fortress. Just in case.

So you set yourself up there, enjoying the view. All you had to do was wait for the Sarranga to bring you the treasures on a silver platter...
Missions_en|296984867425333248: My Lord, the watchful eye of our scouts has not yet found the messengers or their corpses. As I recall, you sent them (the messengers, not the corpses) to deliver to Sarranga the terms we are prepared to release Princess Shankhar. Hopefully, the delay is due to the fact that the messengers got lost on the way back. In that case, we should receive the ransom in a week at the latest.
Missions_en|296984867450499072: My lord, our scouts have been keeping watch night and day to warn us that the Sarranga are coming. Just think how rich we'll be if every one of this crowd carries a bar of gold, or even one emerald! Congratulations, My Lord, your brilliant plan worked. It seems luck is finally on our side.
Missions_en|296984867450499073: My Lord. Consumed by the prospect of quick riches, I made a fatal error in assessing our position. Sarranga have no intention of paying the ransom. All signs, such as battle paint, sharpened swords, and a war cry, show they're on the march.
Missions_en|296984867450499074: I warn you, you not listen. It is be as I said. Sarranga win, you to die. Longer you resist, more terrible death. For me and for these men die, you are sit naked in an anthill.
Missions_en|296984867450499075: My Lord, given the local people's inability to find peaceful solutions, I suggest we don't wait for the next Sarranga attack. I daresay there is enough wealth in the nearby villages and hamlets to allow us to return home from our expedition in triumph. And, importantly, to return alive. I recommend a counterattack since we're already at war.
Missions_en|296984867450499076: You greedy Solifuga. Eat too much, then blow up. So much to die for. Yours to die, mine to die. All because of you. For all that, your head cut off and play ball with it.
Missions_en|296984867450499077: My Lord, you'll be pleased to hear we've already collected half of the demanded ransom. Judging by the weight of looted... I mean to say, the confiscated property of Sarranga. As to its value, there's a lot of alchemical analysis to be done. And that would be better handled under calmer conditions.
Missions_en|296984867450499078: So many times Sarranga attack, you live yet. I mistake in you. Good in fighting. Just bad attack direction. If you free me, I find another enemy. Him you'll plunder better. And leave be me and Sarranga.
Missions_en|296984867450499079: My Lord, a mail hawk has arrived from one of our scouts, keeping a close watch on enemy troop movements. He claims Sarranga sent their best men into battle. The native nobility, so to speak. My point is, that just collecting earrings and personal jewelry from their bodies will probably provide enough treasure. So we have one last attack to survive.
Missions_en|223729699053744140: September 8, 1491. The scouts reported that the undying leader of the Resistance is being held captive by Shankhar's ex-fiancé, a man named Kazakhrutla. Since negotiations have failed, it's now our job to get Scott out of prison.
Missions_en|223729699053744142:
You have moved further away from the last stop and set up a new camp. The True King of Samreignia, along with your loyal servant Snoot, have gone to smooth over the diplomatic mess between the Resistance and Sarranga.

While awaiting their return, you spent your time reading Scott the Bloody's manifests and chatting with Princess Shankhar. She was astonishingly quick to master not only Samreignian language but also your favorite board game.

In return, you tried to show interest in cultural exchange, but your attempts to utter any words in Sarrangian ended with a severely swollen tongue...
Missions_en|391313290594988032:
My Lord, we received a message from Shankhar's ex-fiancé. The Princess kindly translated it for us. And it seems we have once again reached a diplomatic dead end.

The thing is, Kazakhrutla is willing to trade Scott for the Princess. Except that Milady, to put it mildly, is not fond of the idea. She has no intention of returning to her ex, and the Resistance certainly respects a woman's right to choose. And the right of princesses to choose is twice as respected.

It seems we have nothing else to do but to rescue Scott by force. The situation is a little more complicated by the fact that Kazakhrutla, according to him, will also use all means necessary to "free" the Princess. Also, we lost contact with the only scout who knew the location of Scott's prison...
Missions_en|391313290594988034:
My Lord, Princess Shankhar translated another message from Kazakhrutla.

I will not retell it verbatim, for it contains too many unpleasant epithets applied to your person.

To summarize Kazakhrutla's thoughts and to remove his emotions, we can conclude that his patience has run out. Now he will constantly attack us in the hope of winning back his ex-girlfriend.

But there is good news. As long as Shankhar is with us, the Resistance Leader's life is safe. Because by killing him, Kazakhrutla will endanger Milady. Or rather, he feels that way for some reason. I think it's best not to change the mind of our irascible opponent.
Missions_en|391313290594988036:
My Lord, it seems our conflict with Kazakhrutla has reached the protracted stage of a positional struggle.

We must leave forces to defend ourselves and he must do the same to guard Scott's prison.

We should be engaged in expansion and he should be counterattacking in an attempt to get to Princess Shankhar. Judging by the expressive messages we get from him, he's as annoyed by this state of things as we are.
Missions_en|391313290594988037:
My Lord, we have found the prison where our Leader is being held! Unfortunately, there is Sarranga signal beacon nearby.

If my guess is correct, once Scott is free, someone will show up after him. And given the circumstances, I believe every single able-bodied Sarranga under Kazakhrutla's command will jump in pursuit.
Missions_en|391313290594988039:
My Lord, as we expected, Kazakhrutla found out about Scott's rescue almost immediately. A whole horde of enemies set out in pursuit of the True King of Samreignia.

I only hope that all of us, including Scott, survive this attack. Otherwise, there will be no Resistance Leader, and no Resistance anymore...
Missions_en|391313290594988041: Locate and destroy Sarranga's prison to free Scott the Bloody
Missions_en|223729699057938450:
September ?11?, 1491. Princess Shankhar showed her hospitality and allowed us to live among the natives. I expect that a few months of living side by side with Sarranga will give me an understanding of their culture. Only after earning their trust will I be adopted into the tribe. Hopefully they'll consider me worthy enough to lead them.

The amount of resources and the extraction speed is reduced.
Missions_en|223729699057938452:
Apparently, because of the cultural difference, Sarranga leader mistook the simple gesture of hospitality for an expression of your desire to be at her complete disposal.

It was difficult to argue with the interlocutor's interpretation. And quite reckless, considering the presence of natives who use cleavers as toothpicks.

Princess Shankhar led your group into the wilderness and gestured that you should build a city there. A city that would be a new home for you and Sarranga. After that, the Princess left, having promised that she would come back and check how you had done...
Missions_en|337888216269963264:
My Lord, I have certain concerns that we can build a city without the support of the local people. Her Highness has given us men, so it won't hurt to prove our loyalty to them.

It is impossible to predict Princess' reaction in the event that we do not fulfill her instructions. However, I think it is wise to remain in the dark on this matter. Therefore, I suggest we imbue ourselves with the beliefs and ideas of the natives.

As you well know, cultural exchange is the bridge between civilizations. And since you have decided to cross that bridge and become a Sarranga, you have to earn their respect. As I understand it, the easiest way to join the local culture is to participate in their Rituals.
Missions_en|337888216278351872:
My Lord, I have learned what the Sarranga Rituals are and when the next one will begin.

Perhaps, I'm not yet sufficiently imbued with the local culture. Which is why I take the essence of the ritual with a grain of salt. Still, Sarranga believe that a Messenger of the Gods will appear in the Ritual Circle near the Townhall no later than tomorrow.

They are also convinced that with the departure of the Messenger will come "hard times." And in order to survive these hard times, the Messenger of the Gods must be... attacked.

I still have my doubts about the hard times and the appearance of someone out of thin air in the Ritual Circle. But, My Lord, I'm pretty sure that beating up whoever Sarranga think is the Messenger of the Gods will increase your reputation in the tribe.
Missions_en|337888216278351873:
My Lord, the Ritual has begun. It is strictly forbidden by Sarranga tradition to work during the event. But there is a wonderful opportunity for your men to find more decent employment.

For something has indeed materialized in the Ritual Circle. If the Sarranga were right in their predictions, perhaps they are right in other things.

According to their religion, the gods are willing to give whatever is necessary to get the tribe through the "hard times." The more impressed the gods are with your attacks on their Messenger, the easier it will be for all of us in the future.
Missions_en|337888216278351874:
My Lord, unlike the appearance of the Messenger of the Gods, the 'hard times' that the Sarranga so insistently warned about have a rational explanation.

The fact is that our city is located in an arid climate. Under certain weather conditions, we run the risk of experiencing a rise in temperature that is critical for agriculture. Actually, not just for agriculture. but for all living things.

Simply put, My Lord, we will soon be facing a Drought. And while it lasts, we can't get food except by hunting. Sadly enough, it's the Yummy Bugs that we'll be after. Because there's nothing else to hunt for. I'd also expect a certain drop in the birth rate. The city's population is unlikely to grow in harsh weather conditions.
Missions_en|414066514338885632:
My Lord, a message from our watchful scouts. To add to our many misadventures, it seems that we are not the only ones who is having trouble finding food during the Drought. The local fauna as well shares the same issue with us.

The huge bugs, which we had hitherto hunted relatively unpunished, seem to have come to consider humans as a source of quite suitable food.

This exciting behavioral paradigm shift has led to an impressive swarm of giant Coleoptera representatives coming towards us...
Missions_en|414066514359857152:
My Lord, I keep studying the Sarranga language and culture. I discovered that the tribe you have chosen to assimilate with is historically at odds with another race that inhabits the lands of the Uncharted Continent.

The Sarranga themselves call them the "Not-Alives" and claim that these mysterious people are responsible for the fall of the once great Empire, now divided into several tribes. Those tribes, however, are now trying to unite again.

Although I remain skeptical of local superstitions, I have come to the conclusion that if we can get rid of what the Sarranga call the "Not-Alives", it will definitely have a positive effect on their attitude towards you. More importantly, it will have a positive effect on the Princess' attitude towards you.

Therefore, My Lord, I highly recommend you visit the North-East. According to our scouts, there are ruins of an ancient city of the Sarranga Empire. Now inhabited, presumably, by the Undead.
Missions_en|223729699057938453: Gain Sarranga reputation points by dealing damage to Messengers of the Gods
Missions_en|186833502343114772: September ?12?, 1491. My prisoner Princess Shankhar knows where to find treasure in these alien lands. We only need to "borrow" the gifts buried in some strange tombs. There is one thing that worries me a bit. The architecture of the tombs differs from what I've seen in the Sarranga settlements.
Missions_en|186833502343114774:
If you become a Tomb Raider, the Ransom for the Princess mission will lock.

You were cautious about a possible escalation of conflict with the natives and rejected the idea of ransoming the princess. Instead, you decided to get the gold peacefully.

Princess Shankhar led your party to the tombs. Looting tombs has always been one of the safest and surest ways to get rich.

Waiting for your men to bring treasures to the fortress (which you had built so that no one could touch the expected loot) you dreamed of returning to your homeland. With chests full of gold and precious stones...
Missions_en|299937496111624192:
Uhm... "Meelord", troubles. Called Nightmare Generals. They defend tombs. I see not anything like this before. Very strange. And bad. You don't want more trouble, you must get rid of them.

Treasure must gather, too. At first I think it be easy, but it don't be be easy. It be hard. My bad, sorry. But I believe you can manage.
Missions_en|299937496111624193:
I knew it! I foresaw this day would come! I've strengthened the Tomb security for a reason, you see. I knew a special player would show up. A player without even a trace of a moral compass. Raiding tombs! Shame on you! I mean, it'd be fine if we were talking about tombs of some long-dead civilization. It'd be fine if it was to find a powerful artifact. But NO! You did it just to satisfy a thirst for profit. How mercantile of you! How low!

How did they even grant you a knighthood? Aren't you embarrassed to look in the mirror in the morning, "My Lord"?
But Undeads have an asymmetrical response for you. Soon enough, you will die. And then I will resurrect you and kill you again. And again. And again. And I'll keep doing it until you wake up and get a conscience.
Missions_en|299937496111624194:
At first, I thought "My Lord" had been watching too much Indiana Jones. Or maybe you're a fan of polygonal Lara Croft. A Nathan Drake fan, at least. If you were a banal wannabe, we'd have squashed you like a bug a long time ago.

I'm still not convinced, though. But you keep up your great performance. In the meantime, I'll be deep in thought about your fate after death. It doesn't take a vision to understand that sooner or later, we'll kill you anyway.
Missions_en|299937496111624195:
I have to admit, Nightmare General is not everyone's cup of tea. On the one hand, I can make more of them. On the other hand...

Did you ever think that this General might have had dreams of his own? Maybe his favorite Siamese cat, Max, was waiting for him at home.

But you don't care, do you? You just want to check all the boxes for the mission.

Right, the script says I'm going to unleash my full wrath on you. (Not really, only as much as the Developers allow to).
Missions_en|299937496111624196:
So, the show must go on.

Hah.

Hah. Hah.

Muah-hah-hah-haaaa.

You've fought off roughly half of the attacks. This won't be the end of it. See you later. You're gonna die.

You're gonna die many, many times. Not to mention quick loadings.
Missions_en|299937496111624197: Meelord! We've collected half of the treasures. With a little more effort, we can collect it all. I mean, all we can carry.
Missions_en|299937496111624198:
I've come out of my deep thoughts about your future. I decided it would be a continuation of your present. Namely, I'm going to try to drive you out of the world with absolutely no malice.

But if you pass this mission, I will deem you worthy to hear the Song. And perhaps, just perhaps, I'll honor you by a request to join me in death.
Missions_en|299937496111624199:
How are you doing, My Lord? Have you built trebuchets? Have the walls been erected? What about archers? Are they in position? Are your civilians secured?

It would be disgraceful to raze your settlement to the ground if you couldn't fight back. Unsportsmanlike, don't you agree?

I don't have much to decide here, though. The clock is ticking. And I warn you, almost as a friend, my army will arrive soon.
Missions_en|299937496111624200:
Now you're looking at the counter in the lower left corner, next to the horned icon, thinking that the attacks are over. That you can now safely complete the mission objectives? That's not how it works today!

My game, my rules. The attack you just repelled will repeat. Again. And again. And again. And again. And... I can keep saying it forever. But can you keep resisting forever? That's for us to find out.
Missions_en|186833502343114777: October ?31?, 1491. My men are exhausted. I have insomnia. For nearly a month we've been wandering in an unknown direction, and the farther we go, the stronger the feeling that the very earth itself is resisting our presence here. Sometimes I think I hear the terrifying sounds of thunder. But it doesn't rain. It's as if someone is hunting us, following our trail.
Missions_en|186833502343114779:
Forced to go deeper into an uncharted continent without a sign of promised treasures, you were learning a pioneer's lot the hard way.

Provisions were replenished with no idea what, and people got sick with scabies from time to time. In addition, at night your party suffered from attacks of an unknown origin.

To stabilize the situation somehow, you decided to camp in the valley, where the water at least smelled good. And it was like things were starting to get better. But you felt that it was the calm before the storm...
Missions_en|299937496111624203:
My Lord, there is a serious flaw in our plan to flee. Turns out the undead can run faster than us.

In addition, the blind march we made led us into their domain. So, without going into all the details, it appears that we did, uh... an invasion.

Our only hope is that the Undead are not familiar with books on the art of war. Otherwise, our maneuver risks becoming the shortest assault in history. With only the hulk of this fortress to remind our descendants of our deeds.
Missions_en|299937496115818496:
So, who's the last in the queue to be killed and resurrected? No one? Then you, My Lord, are the first. And the only one.

But let's respect the rules of drama. Before I take you seriously and reveal the Song's innermost essence, beat back ordinary, unremarkable attacks for now.

In fact, one is coming.
Missions_en|443708606790873088:
So who's the last person in line to be slaughtered? No one? Well, then, you, My Lord, are the first. And the only one.

But let's respect the drama, shall we? After all, a battle with the boss is serious business. You won't win it in a hurry. And it's important to stay in shape; keep yourself toned, you know.

Firstly, you have to defeat some usual, totally unremarkable attacks.There's one coming, by the way.
Missions_en|299937496115818497:
My Lord, it's incredible the fortress is still holding. When we return home, I will find an excellent and relatively inexpensive writer to compose a book on your behalf, "Castle Attack. Or how I used diplomacy to piss off my opponents so badly that they all died storming my citadel."

I am convinced that the brilliant tactical genius of the descendant of Duncan Ironbrow will find its admirers. The book will turn the theory about the proportions of casualties in offensive military operations upside down.
Missions_en|299937496115818498:
Well, My Lord, don't you think it's time to finish the practice and fight for real? So they can write a heroic and monumental epic about the battle in your homeland?

I should stop lying though. There will be no one to chronicle your feats. For you are doomed to an ignominious death. And if you do return to your homeland, it will only be to carry the divine sounds of the Song.

Still, since we're talking about epic, a hero needs an antagonist. I've got one in mind. You're not going anywhere until you meet the prince of darkness, the Great and Powerful Ozzy.
Missions_en|299937496115818499:
My Lord, I have some disturbing news. We discovered that the Undead are not coming out of nowhere. Someone or something is summoning them here.

Despite the obvious advantages of our defensive tactics during an attack, I would still recommend raiding enemy territory.

Something tells me that by eliminating the source of the Undead attacks, we'll feel safer.
Missions_en|299937496115818500:
My lord, we received mail hawks from our scouts. The messages are chaotic and slightly unsettling in their content. I read them all. Amidst the vivid emotional assessments and juicy soldierly epithets, there is a golden thread running through the sentiments of utter confusion and blatant moral decay.

Simply put, we have very poor ideas, spiced with superstition and obvious hyperbole, about who is going to attack us this time and in what numbers.
Missions_en|299937496115818501:
My Lord, my condolences to you for hearing the Song. I have to admit, I realize now that we're not fighting for survival. Or even for Samreignia.

The coming victory over the Undead is humanity's greatest victory over the bad taste.
Missions_en|299937496115818502:
I have opened my arms, ready to reveal to you the true principles of the universe. I have gifted you, initiated you into the mystery of the Song. I saw you not as a pawn in this game, but as a full-value piece.

And how did you repay me? By stabbing me in the back? All right, I apologize for my tone. I don't mean to be so pathetical.

But still. We skipped the light fandango. You actually killed me! Naturally, I was resurrected. But my dead heart is broken forever. I believed in you! I thought you were the chosen one who would spread the Song to the people like Prometheus did with fire.

Now I think I'm just gonna crush you. If not in this mission, then in the next.
Missions_en|299937496115818503:
How long are you going to cowardly hide behind your castle walls?

At first, your antagonist was bored. Then he was sad. Then he got angry.

And I fear this is only the beginning of the probation. The Resistance's keen scouts are certain that other types of troops that the enemy can produce in "structures of appropriate purpose" will also begin to gather at our walls in the foreseeable future.
Missions_en|390821316049874950:
From the technical point of view, My Lord, this message carries no meaning. After all, you can see on the mini-map yourself how a horde of my loyal soldiers is approaching your Townhall. So you can just close the dialog box. But the Developers gave me a couple of paragraphs to improvise... And I, as a perfect villain should, decided to tell you about my wicked Plan!

It's very simple. When I possess the Ancestral Sword, the Sarranga will come under my banner. After that, I will slaughter them all. Then I'll sail across the sea with an enormous army and take Samreignia. And kill everyone there.

But I will do all this without malice. I will do it because it is the only way I can reveal to all the people the one true value of the fictional world of Diplomacy is Not an Option. Listening to the Song it is. And you, My Lord, are not going to stop me!
Missions_en|390821316049874952: Shankhar must deliver the Ancestral Sword to the Place of Power
Missions_en|390821316049874951: Repulse the final attack of the Undead
Missions_en|390188006114177026:
With the Ancestral Sword and your ally Princess Shankhar, you arrived in the capital of the Sarranga Tribes, the glorious city of Niniende.

Though everything pointed to the Resistance receiving long-awaited reinforcements, you tried not to get your hopes up.

After all, life had convinced you that your luck was made of glass if not clay, and it usually shatters...
Missions_en|223729699057938460: ?November 18? 1491. We slew a monster named Ozzy. We even managed to load his head onto the giant beetle summoned by my Princess. Now we must take that head to the Sarranga's capital. The city of Niniende.
Missions_en|223729699057938462:
Becoming a loyal subject of Shankhar means that from now on you share the Princess's dream of the restoration of the great Sarranga empire. To make it come true, you needed to bring to Sarranga capital the proof that the war against the Undead could be won. And you had one: the trophy head of the creepy monster Ozzy.

But how could you get the massive head to the capital? Even a herd of horses would be exhausted by such a burden. Well, Princess came up with a solution. Not a common one, it must be said. And that solution was... a giant tamed beetle.

With Ozzy's head on the insect's back, you set off on your journey to Niniende. Although the weather was just lovely, you weren't in the best of moods. For you were travelling through the land of the Undead. And they were not asleep. (Why would they?)
Missions_en|415180671792558080:
My Lord! The vehicle to transport Ozzy's head isn't exactly fast, and Niniende is a long way from here. However, the journey promises to be quite exciting.

For, as our keen scouts report, the Undead are already chasing us, and they will get us soon enough.

There is every reason to believe that we will have to repulse the attack. Only then will we have time to decide our next move.
Missions_en|415180671792558081:
Ahem, My Lord. Since we were fortunate enough to survive the attack, I think this is a proper moment to consider our further strategy.

I fear this Undead's attempt to retrieve Ozzy's head wasn't the last one. If they get their hands on our Porter Bug, we can hardly count on their mercy. No doubt they'll kill us too.

Since our operational planning center is mobile (and not very maneuverable, I should mention), we're somewhat limited in what we can do. Obviously, building defenses is pretty pointless. Therefore, I recommend throwing all your resources into hiring new troops.

Our vigilant scouts have marked enemy depots on the map. We could raid them and loot their resources. Could be risky, I agree. We'd have to weaken Bug's escort. But in this case, I think it's worth the risk because it would allow us to hire more warriors.
Missions_en|415180671792558082:
My Lord, we are already halfway to Niniende. Our dedicated scouts report that they have managed to infiltrate the enemy camp and blend in with the mob.

They have obtained valuable information. First, our mobile operational planning center's route is well known to the enemy. The scouts recommend us to change it. But we can't do that. We aren't the ones controlling the Bug.

Therefore, we can move on to the second piece of valuable information. The undeads are planning three more attacks. The scouts even gave us the approximate locations of the ambushes. Given our speed, I'd say the first attack will take place no later than tomorrow.
Missions_en|415180671792558083: Meelord! Distant Sarranga outpost approach. Bug is slow, it takes him long to pass Outpost. While he travel, we hire Sarranga warriors. Sarranga run after we and protect Bug.
Missions_en|415180671792558084:
My lord! This is the last Sarranga outpost on our way to Niniende.

I strongly advise you to recruit more Sarranga to our ranks, for there are Undead ambushes ahead.
Missions_en|415180671792558085:
Meelord! Not-Alives lose all fear and conscience! They attack us right outside Niniende.

Obvious: they desperate and stupid. Now we kill them and park Bug. Leave hardest part behind.
Missions_en|415180671796752384:
Aaaaah! Disaster! Alive nightmare. Scarier than any Not-Alive. Scarier than anything you ever-ever see!

You find bloodthirsty Beast of Caerbannog! Flee! Run for life! If he see us, he finish us!
Missions_en|415180671796752385:
Sure it... uhm dead? Bunny is sneaky-sneaky. He much pretend. Lure to prey get closer.

No, it dead. For real. How you manage to kill it without Holy Hand Grenade?
Missions_en|432829843731492864:
Meelord!

I find spyglass in saddlebag! I look inside and what I see? Not-Alives are active. When Not-Alives are active – they attack. Soon. I mean, tomorrow.

Bug approach to our fortress. There you hire brave Sarranga warriors, and reinforcements are appear. Hopefully, reinforcements appear in time. And we repel attack.
Missions_en|223729699057938463: Escort Pequod, the Juggernaut Bug to the destination point
