But if you seriously believe you can defeat us, know this: The Unbreakable Army, that guards the northern borders of our Unshakable Empire, is on its way to punish you and consign your name to oblivion, whatever you think of yourself...
Missions_en|3491158024589578167:
They say in Gorgoth: ‘The line between foolishness and courage is thinner than the beautiful wing of a butterfly.’ Only now have I realised that this is no figure of speech. Thank you, Connor Ironbrow, for teaching me this lesson.

You defeated the Unbreakable Army, that much is true. But don’t think that was the only obstacle in your reckless path.

For now the Invincible Army is rushing to help me, the very force that guards the southern borders of our Glorious Empire.
Missions_en|1626881529376407992:
You've achieved more than one victory over the Eternal Empire today, thus earning my respect, Unrecognized Prince.

I ask you: is it truly easier to face death than to sign a peace treaty? After all, you do have the opportunity. Intoxicated by your bloodlust, you're deaf to the voice of reason. Inexperience and overconfidence will be your demise.

The second assistant to the third vice-admiral of the sixth Sand Bull Flotilla of the Gorgothian Armada himself, L'och D'Ruggo, is coming for you. You have nothing to counter his heroic cavalry charge.
Missions_en|5924049329580225610:
My Prince!

While we are technically besieging the enemy city, the enemy is counter-attacking us for real.

If you’re hoping to win, you need to act quickly. The longer we delay taking direct steps to destroy the enemy’s fortifications and buildings, the stronger their counter-attacks are likely to be, according to forecasts.
Missions_en|6481836166634062582:
What have you done, Mad Prince?!! Though what sort of prince would you be? You’re merely an uncivilised, heartless savage.

The building you’ve destroyed isn’t just some wooden little tower. Do you have any idea how many sleepless nights the architects spent searching for a way to erect something so spectacular in the middle of this desert? Can you imagine how much sweat the Gorgothian workers shed whilst building it?

What now? You have buried the symbol of our Almighty Empire’s power in the sands. This is something we cannot forgive. Mark my words: from now on, we'll fight you to the last soldier.
Missions_en|5752138458090968597:
My Prince!

Since the enemy, namely Some Noble Gorgothian Guy, kindly informs us of their upcoming attacks and reinforcement arrivals, our scouts have nothing to do.

To keep themselves busy, they’ve organised surveillance of the enemy’s camps. For a couple of weeks now, I’ve been receiving the same report: ‘The enemy is twiddling their thumbs’. But today, the message is unexpectedly different: ‘Several small Gorgotian units left the camps and are heading towards your positions’.
Missions_en|3232342375394955972:
My Prince!

We've destroyed a Gorgothian building where prisoners of war were held.

Luckily, they escaped from the rubble alive. Otherwise, someone might one day accuse us of violating some international convention signed by whatever Samreignian monarch.

The prisoners of war, by the way, are Inverlanders. They can’t wait to settle the score with the Gorgothians, so there’s no need to capture them again. With the real Inverlanders by our side, your staged attack will be even more convincing!
Missions_en|3020708405991089785: Bring down Gorgothian Prisoner of War Camps
Missions_en|669183009612619777: Inverland has a highly trained engineer who designs siege weapons of incredible power. Together with my Prince, we came to the obvious conclusion that it would be much better for everyone if this engineer worked for us. Now we just need to ‘convince’ the Inverlanders and bring the engineer to our side.
Missions_en|669183009608425485:
Now that our Gorgothian captive, who happens to be Vice-Princess Nayana, has escaped, returning to the peace process with Gorgoth is out of the question. As is staging attacks on Gorghothian fortresses. Nevertheless, My Prince hasn't lost heart and has entrusted me with exploring options for our next steps.

Our scouts' report contains an image of a new siege weapon that the enemy is planning to put into production.

Behind every outstanding invention lies human genius. The only thing left is to figure out how to get our hands on this particular genius working for Inverland...
Missions_en|9077885558443540317:
My Prince!

Scouts revealed the location of the famous engineer Leonardo Brillianti. The Top-Secret Workshop that is.

You might ask, where is this Workshop? My answer is: it’s in a well-guarded Inverland fortress! That was something we were prepared for.

What we weren’t prepared for, though, was the enemy’s magical warning system. If we manage to destroy the Workshop and <#ABA291>kidnap Master Leonardo, an entire army will run after him.
Missions_en|442981929776094218:
My Prince!

It turns out that the enemy’s warning system is a bit more sensitive than we expected. Inverland knows we are here. They have sent a certain regiment to rescue the fortress garrison.

According to our eagle-eyed scouts, the number of troops in this regiment and the quality of their training are utterly laughable. However, it remains unclear who is about to laugh — us or the Inverlanders.

Therefore, if I were you, I’d prepare to repel an attack of moderate danger.
Missions_en|5169015296794162080:
My Prince!

I don't wish to rush you, as the undertaker said when he entered the room of a dying man, but Inverland is plotting evil again.

The enemy is not pleased that we still have a chance of successfully completing the mission. As a result, they are about to unleash the cavalry upon us.

If I may, here are some suggestions: crush the cavalry, destroy the Workshop, and bring Master Leonardo to our positions. This must be done immediately. As for how to do it, that’s for you to decide.
Missions_en|2107290642806124718:
My Prince!

Missions_en|588951257845448709:
My Lord, if you played through the story campaign for Sarranga, you clearly recognize this chapter of your journey. The chapter where you take Ozzy's head away from the lands of the dead.

I tinkered with time and space a bit so that you would stop yourself from the past. In a sense, I sent you on a suicide mission, m'kay...

So where was I? We can't let Pequod, the bug carrying Ozzy's head, reach its destination. So kill it and anyone who tries to protect it.
Missions_en|588951257849643008:
Do you even realize what you've done, My Lord? You should have destroyed the Bug at once, and the challenge would have ended. A wounded bug is more dangerous than an unharmed one.

Now it will spawn Sarranga troops. From now on, you will have to take care of them as well.
Missions_en|588951257849643009:
Oops... Looks like there's been a tiny mistake here. I must have overtinkered time and space a bit, because there was nothing like this in the mission for Sarranga. And now there is. Namely, there are reinforcements from the native armies that will attack you from the South-East. My bad, sorry.

But you're an experienced commander, so you should be able to handle this. After all, we're in the game about base defending. So go ahead, defend it.
Missions_en|588951257849643010:
You there? Maybe, got distracted by Spotify or Apple TV? If so, pause the game. The clock is ticking, and the Bug is getting closer to its destination.

Also, here comes another attack. If you keep going like this, you're gonna lose.
Missions_en|588951257849643015: Kill Pequod before he reaches his destination
Missions_en|588951257849643012: As you well know, capturing something is only half the solution. Because once captured, this something must be held. Which is what you are about to do. After a fierce battle, your undead army has captured the ruins of the once-great city of the Sarranga tribe. There is very little time to prepare for a counterattack. Fortunately, part of the city walls has survived the previous attack...
Missions_en|588951257849643013:
My Lord, it was yesterday that I congratulated you on your stunning and unexpected (even for your humble servant) victory. You achieved the impossible: capturing the entire city of Sarranga without any losses is something you call a feat.

But that was yesterday. And today, our vigilant scouts brought alarming news: the Sarranga army is only a day's march away from here.

We have little time left to prepare our defenses. I would like to draw your attention to the fact that currently our archers occupy only the remains of the outer city wall. It is probably worth deploying troops on other defensive structures.
Missions_en|588951257849643014: My Lord, I brought you news that will undoubtedly please you. Our vigilant scouts were highly accurate in their reports! Exactly a day has passed, and the enemy army is approaching.
Missions_en|588951257849643017: To win this challenge, you simply need to erect the Transgressor of the Undead. It seems we're missing something... Ah, yes! The rift for construction is in the East, and your Citadel is in the West. So, you'll have to create the defiled land “across the equator” of the entire map. Don't forget about the enemies: they're there too.
Missions_en|588951257849643018:
My Lord, the Ninth Twilight Overlord made a wager with the Sarranga chiefs to see who would be the first to build a Transgressor in this gorge. He asked us to win the bet for him.

We are in an exceptionally favorable position, just a few miles West from the only source of Soul Crystals. If we manage to defile the gorge with Monuments and reach the rift, we are certain to win.

Your eyeless undead scouts have spotted no signs of Sarranga in the region, except for a couple of builders' camps. However, I am almost certain that the cunning natives will try to find a way to slow us down.
Missions_en|588951257849643019:
My Lord, I was not wrong in my assumption about Sarranga's attempts to slow us down.

Seeing that their builder brigades are lazy and sluggish, they brought in troops from the East to slow down the process of soil defilement.

A rather dirty way to win the bet, I must admit.
Missions_en|588951257849643020:
My Lord, Sarranga's treachery and deceit know no bounds! Now they decided to attack from the West. That is, right at our Citadel.

However, one cannot deny the logic of these despicable natives. If the Citadel falls, they will have more than enough time to build their Transgressor before the Twilight Overlord resurrects us and throws us into this gorge.

We have no choice but to divide our forces between two fronts.
Missions_en|588951257849643021:
My Lord, for some reason, the builders from the Sarranga camps have come to the conclusion that destruction is better than construction. They've quickly reclassified themselves as warriors.

From now on, they'll be making raids on our positions from all the camps in the region.
Missions_en|588951257845448706: The challenges in this section focus on battles between the Undead against bosses and mini-bosses. Experience the power of the dark side as you face the most dangerous enemies in the game!
Missions_en|588951257853837318: Let the tournament begin: Crabs, Heffalumps, and Bugs have sent their best combatants against you. Be sure to return the favor: this challenge presents you with a rare opportunity to spawn as many Nightmare Generals as possible. However, it's up to you whether the final battle will feel like a clash of titans or like a duel between David and Goliath.
Missions_en|588951257853837322:
My Lord, you are honored to represent the Undead in the Tournament of the Millennium, which, as you can easily guess, is held annually. The rules are simple: contenders pit their champions against the Undead settlement. If they win, we leave their race unharmed until the next tournament.

Considering our geopolitical plans, we absolutely must win this. Bookmakers estimate our chances at 50 to 1.

What the bookmakers don't know is that this year we have the Overcharged Dark Generator, allowing us to power up a much larger army. I would recommend hiring more Nightmare Generals and betting half the settlement's budget on our victory.
Missions_en|588951257853837319:
My Lord, the draw has just taken place, and I am pleased to inform you that our first opponent was revealed. It is the Crabs.

I suppose it will come as no surprise to you that among the attackers we will see some of the most powerful representatives of the crustaceans. I am talking about the Emperor Crabs.
Missions_en|588951257853837320: My Lord, I have wonderful news: Sarranga and the Royal Army fought each other to the death for the right to face us second. They have all been declared technically defeated, and we have advanced to the quarterfinals, where we will face the Heffalumps. By the way, they are already here.
Missions_en|588951257853837321: My Lord, we've made it to the final round. Thing is, all the remaining contenders were eaten by bugs. And now, well-fed and vicious, they're coming for us, led by their Queens.
Missions_en|588951257853837312: Ozzy, the Great and Powerful gave such an electrifying performance for Sarranga that they made him their idol. Surrounded by the love of his fans, he completely detached himself from his undead roots and no longer seeks to bring terror and destruction. However, when the 'friend or foe' system fails in this way, there is only one proven solution: death followed by resurrection...
Missions_en|588951257853837313:
So, My Lord, we have a situation here that threatens to become a dangerous precedent. The one that could shake the foundations of the undead society. Sarranga started listening to our music, bypassing the mandatory 'say goodbye to life' step.

For that, we have our good friend Ozzy to thank. He went on tour to Sarranga lands a week ago. And now he seems so happy with the attention from his new audience that he has decided not to come back. A classic case of star fever.

I'm appointing you, My Lord, as Ozzy's new manager. So cleaning this whole mess is your duty now. Find the renegade and return him to the Undead... Dead. And don't get killed by the natives. They'll probably try to protect their idol.
Missions_en|588951257853837314: My Lord, I felt it necessary to warn you: the Sarranga camps came to life. From this moment on, native warriors will be leaving them. And these warriors will attack your fortress.
Missions_en|588951257853837315:
Here he is, the black sheep who strayed from his undead flock. The white crow who thought that the ears of the living were worthy of hearing the unearthly sounds of the Song. Ozzy, once the Great and Powerful, became a parody of himself.

He went mainstream. He began to attract a mass audience. Now his most devoted fans are Sarranga and other non-sentient riff-raff. So painful for me to even think about it!

But we'll bring him back to the true path. We have to kill him first, though.
Missions_en|588951257853837316:
Now, my lord, you should hurry up and kill Ozzy. I checked the map settings and found that the last attack you repelled is going to repeat itself.

Attacking and defending at the same time is not a very pleasant task. It won't be long before you lose...
Missions_en|634658565520076810: In the Challenges in this section, your main task is to find proper places for your Towers, Fortifications, and Ranged troops. The emphasis is on the tower-defense component of the game.
Missions_en|634658565511688192: A sad story about the rector of the Milord's Institute of Technology, who is forced to protect his University after suddenly losing his grants. First, from tax collectors, and then from students who are unable to receive their education due to a lack of funds.
Missions_en|634658565520076801:
Honorable Rector!

As you are aware, our Institute relies on international grants for funding. Unfortunately, the ships carrying these international grants sank after an attack by a Sea Monster.

As your accountant, I immediately reported this to the relevant fiscal authority with a request to defer income tax collection. However, my request was denied.

Given the situation, the only way to postpone payment is to get rid of the tax collectors who are about to arrive.
Missions_en|634658565520076802:
Honorable Rector!

The location of the institute, as you envisioned, symbolizes our always open doors. Yet it would be preferable if we could close them on occasion.

Because students, having learned of our financial issues, want to finish the semester early, and we don't even have money to print grade books, not to mention organizing exam committees.

Professors of the Faculty of Fence Construction, fearing public unrest, advise you to build fortifications along the main alley.
Missions_en|634658565520076803:
Honorable Rector!

The tax collectors have got completely @#$%ing mad. I received a statement that since we can’t pay the tax on the grants (which, I remind you, have sunk), they are sending a team of bailiffs here.

If we don't do anything, they will arrest all of the institute's property. As for the university building, it’ll be put up for auction.
Missions_en|637207299537641472:
Honorable Rector!

Foreign students from the Sarranga tribe joined the rebellious local students. They are demanding a refund of their tuition fees and language test charges.

The latter, by the way, is an untenable claim, since they all failed the language test. Except for the chief's nephew, who receives remote education.
Missions_en|637207299537641473:
Honorable Rector!

It seems that student unrest is coming to an end. Because we are running out of students. For obvious reasons, new students are in no hurry to enroll in our esteemed educational establishment.

But there is also bad news: tax forces have been sent to dismantle our property. Their task is to tear down the Institute brick by brick and sell it as construction materials.

If you've read this far, I feel compelled to explain myself. In fact, our grants did not sink, but were “mistakenly” delivered to my bank deposit box. I really wanted everything to end peacefully. But since the situation got totally out of hand, I’m just gonna take my money and hit the road. Good luck to you, Honorable Rector! Catch you later!
Missions_en|634658565511688194: The East Sarrangian Company has long been trying to tame the giant coleoptera from the Uncharted Continent. The latest theory conceived by the brilliant minds of the scientific department goes like this: if you cover the Monument with petunia oil, bugs will think that the Monument is their Queen. Your task is to ensure the safety of the experiment designed to test this hypothesis.
Missions_en|634658565520076804:
Dear Partner! Thank you for volunteering to supervise the security of the Petunia experiment, aimed at transforming the Bugs of the Uncharted Continent into a formidable force under the control of the East Sarrangian Company.

Please be advised that the Monument you see before you cannot be destroyed under any circumstances, as it is valuable corporate property. I feel it necessary to add that the experiment has been pre-approved as “moderately successful” because Bugs truly perceive the Monument as the Queen of their species. However, they perceive it as the Queen of a hostile hive... or anthill... or colony. Because of this, they react to its existence with significant aggression.

While our research department works hard on improving the Monument, you are responsible for ensuring its safety. Unfortunately, we were not prepared for such a turn of events, and your supplies are insufficient for the successful accomplishment of the mission. We recommend improvising and, if possible, obtaining resources from destroyed insects.
Missions_en|634658565520076805:
Dear Partner! The Scientific Department considers it necessary to inform you that the Monument has a cumulative effect on giant representatives of the Coleoptera.

The theoretical data and scientific principles underlying the effect are considered the intellectual property of the East Sarrangian Company and are therefore confidential. However, you should be aware that in the very near future, our valuable corporate property will be targeted for annihilation by the queens of the bug hives ...or anthills ...or colonies. The Monument's estimated radius of influence is between 17.5 and 212.25 miles.

We highly recommend you increase the level of security.
Missions_en|634658565520076800: From the peninsula located in the river delta, you must protect the Temple of Joy from the Undead. The problem is that the Temple blocks the passage to the paths of Undead forces. So you’ll have to solve this by destroying the enemy with ranged units only.
Missions_en|634658565520076806:
My Lord, as you know, we came here in response to a call for help from the Sarranga tribes, who are suffering from regular attacks by their undead neighbors.

Our mission was to ensure the safety of the Temple of Joy's construction, the completion of which would magically banish the Undead within a 700-mile radius.

However, there was an error in the calculations: Sarranga didn't bring enough stones to build the entire temple complex. The builders have already left for... supplies, as they call it, while we stayed here.

Strategically, the situation has taken a 180-degree turn: according to scout reports, if the Undead were previously afraid to approach and were preparing to relocate, now they are planning an attack...
Missions_en|634658565520076807:
My Lord, our eagle-eyed scouts have returned from their patrol with news that can be classified as “moderately positive.”

Obviously, the Undead are in a hurry to destroy the Temple, so they're sending their troops here in small groups.

Judging by the movements of their forces, instead of gathering all units for a decisive strike, the enemy hopes to create constant pressure on the left and right flanks. Although if I were in them, I would just outnumber us as much as I could. After all, with the Undead, corpses can always be resurrected.
Missions_en|634658565520076808:
My Lord, a mail hawk has arrived from the Sarranga. Also, I have new reports from our keen-eyed scouts. Both pieces of information are a bit worrying. The builders who went to get stones for the Temple complex were spotted in Niniende, at one of the "Passiflora" inns. Something tells me they are taking their sweet time to return and finish the job.

The Undead, on the other hand, are stepping up their game as they have radically strengthened their presence in the area. Thing is, Nightmare Generals joined the three not-so-impressive armies we were supposed to deal with. This could tip the scales against us...
Missions_en|639826090419429379: The challenges in this section are all about romance. Here, mass murders take on a special meaning, because they’re committed in the name of love! (Or, well, because of it...)
Missions_en|639826090415235072: Sometimes, family happiness doesn't last long. Certainly, it doesn't when one of the spouses suddenly disappears. Play as Princess Shankhar and rescue your not-quite-lawful husband, Lord Ironbrow, from captivity. Show the Royal Army that true love knows no bounds. Especially when the Sarranga tribe is fighting for it (and for you).
Missions_en|641272534208749569:
My Lady, following your orders, we crossed the sea in pursuit of the captors of Lord Ironbrow. Our presence here has hardly gone unnoticed, so we have every reason to expect an attack.

I do understand that I'm not in a position to dissuade you... Still, the idea of destroying the Prison where your beloved awaits trial for bigamy— namely, for taking you as his wife while officially married to a citizen of Samreignia — is a rather daring and risky approach to resolving the issue of a long-distance relationship.

According to reports from our eagle-eyed scouts, the Prison is somewhere nearby. However, we'll have to determine its exact location ourselves. I'd also like to point out that an unexpected demolition of a correctional facility will certainly bring the attention of the authorities...
Missions_en|641272534208749570:
My Lady, we've located the place where Lord Ironbrow is imprisoned. I recommend proceeding with caution, as obstructing justice within the territory of Samreignia will have inevitable consequences.

It is possible that, due to the swift response of the authorities, these consequences may include Lord Ironbrow's untimely and tragic demise.

I highly advise you to think through a safe escape plan for your husband before going further with the Prison's removal.
Missions_en|641272534208749571:
My Lady, your husband is free now, safe and sound, after the collapse of the prison walls. At the same time, under the laws of Samreignia, he is a fugitive, which means there will be plenty of people willing to bring him to justice.

If you want this story to have a happy ending, you must ensure that his Lordship has a way to retreat. Or rather, to flee.
Missions_en|639826090419429376: Repulse the final Royal Army's attack
Missions_en|640191330101370880: Lovers are not only found among humans, but also among animals, birds, fish, and even crustaceans. It is worth mentioning that giant crabs, blinded by passion, can pose a danger to people. Even if those people are sheltered behind castle walls. And even if the castle has plenty of defenders.
Missions_en|641272534208749572:
My Lord, forgive me, but I’ve had enough of this. It’s the same thing every spring. The crabs: We’re going to nest at the Love Rock, and not a @#$%'n thing can stop us. You: Wait, is my fortress located near the Love Rock? Me: Unfortunately, yes, My Lord.

Anyways, it's springtime. Again. And no, it is not like in the "Here Comes the Sun" song. Nothing will be alright while the oversized lovesick crabs are up to knock on our gates.
Missions_en|641272534208749573:
My Lord, I hereby declare the mating season for crabs open. The first specimens are about to wake up from their hibernation and, driven by the very basic instinct, to head to the place where their ancestors have been going for what appears to be centuries of evolution. Namely, right here.

Except five years ago, they didn't have any obstacles on their way. As for us, for the fifth year in a row, we have some issues with them regarding the matter of our castle location.
Missions_en|641272534208749574:
My Lord, as you may recall from past experience, some species of giant crustaceans emerge from their winter hibernation later than others. Normally, the larger the specimen, the later spring arrives for them.

So, the lilacs are already in bloom, the swallows have built their nests, and the driftwood in the pond in your courtyard is covered with fresh moss. These are the common signs that Shell crabs will soon be crawling over here.
Missions_en|641272534208749575:
My Lord, look how beautiful the sakura blossoms are by the pond in your courtyard! We have a specific climate, and for that reason, the sakura blooms here later than usual. Namely, right in the middle of the @#$%'n crab invasion!

Right @#$%n now, all the crustaceans in the area are swarming, which looks pretty funny if you don't think about it, to rush to mate at the Love Rock. On the bright side: if we survive this invasion, we’ll be delivering delicious seafood anywhere and in any quantity until the crab meat spoils.

Usually, it’s the celebration of such deliveries that distracts you from security matters. Until next spring...
Missions_en|640191330101370881: Get rid of all the crustaceans in the area
Missions_en|641272534208749568: A loose adaptation of a beautiful tale about a young man who was sent to help build a legendary fortification on the third day after his wedding. Unlike the original ending, in which the young groom dies without ever being reunited with his beloved, you will have an opportunity to complete the construction and eventually come home with victory.
Missions_en|641272534208749576:
Master!

For six days and seven nights, we rose with the sun and marched against the cold winds. We have reached the northern borders of our homeland, where the authority of our Great Ruler ends and begins land of disorder, where barbarians live without law, unguided by anyone.

Here we must erect a wall and draw a boundary between civilization and savagery, for such is the will of our Great Ruler. This wall will inspire awe and dread in the heart of anyone who intends to sow chaos.

I understand that your thoughts are with your beloved, for only three days have passed since your happy wedding. But duty to the Ruler comes before any other. By his command, we must put an end to any attempts by the barbarians from the north to attack us, whatever the cost.
Missions_en|641272534208749577:
Master!

I believe this is the last time the barbarians — also known as “cutthroats” — will invade the lands of our Great and Wise Ruler. Today, they will learn that committing lawlessness, plundering, and murder is wrong, and that their deeds will never again go unpunished.

The Wall we have erected will stand for centuries, while their names will be doomed to oblivion. Never again will a single cutthroat approach our lands from the north within the range of a flying projectile. Much less within the range of a flying arrow.

Today, we are fulfilling the will of our Great Ruler. And tomorrow you will be free to return home, where your wife awaits you by the family hearth.
Let us prepare, for the enemy is already at the gates.
Missions_en|140487740017717249: In this section we have put together challenges designed for a long game. You're going to build your city from scratch and defend it against a certain number of enemy attacks.
Missions_en|140488129614032897: The enemy will attack you in waves, while you're going to defend your settlement. Royal forces will try to take your castle nine times.
Missions_en|140488129614032899: The enemy will attack you in waves, while you're going to defend your settlement. Peasants will attack you ten times.
Missions_en|140488129614032901: They've created an army of their own, called 'Hulks Utd'. Their only wish is to test it against your walls. What will be the score?
Missions_en|135060993621598208: This section is for unusual challenges. The conditions of the game map will force you to change your usual tactics and find a new approach to win.
Missions_en|135060993621598210: What picturesque countryside - lakes and forests all around. A little clarification: there are enemies in the forests, and sources of stone and iron are nowhere to be found.
Missions_en|135060993621598212: My lord, you are surrounded! Enemy camps are everywhere, no one can get past them unnoticed. The signal is about to be given for a decisive attack, and all enemies in the area will join in. To keep things fair, we provided you with an enormous amount of resources at the start of the game.
Missions_en|135060993621598214: The map is covered with corpses, which means you'll have to operate in a totally unsanitary environment. Not only that, but periodically the dead will rise to life and rush into battle.
Missions_en|137473534024593408: My lord, dead will rise tonight. Brace yourself!
Missions_en|135060993625792512: Scott the Bloody has been spawned in unimaginable numbers, so now the army of clones is coming after you. The good news is that there are virtually no other enemies, and plenty of resources are given at the start to prepare for the siege.
Missions_en|140487217126420480: In this section, we've put together challenges that aren't exactly challenges. The most relaxing Diplomacy is Not an Option experience.
Missions_en|140487217126420482: The easiest challenge we could make.
Missions_en|140824529169395712: Step into the shoes of an almighty wizard, single-handedly dispersing swarms of enemies with powerful spells. It's a very tight map, but you won't be short on soul crystals.
Missions_en|140824529144229888: I'm a mage, I don't need an army!
Missions_en|141227921557532672: The peasants think their so called army is a threat. It is up to you to convince them they are gravely mistaken.
Missions_en|188630042728574976: In the challenges of this section you will go to a mysterious lands inhabited by a race of the Undead. Its people are not fond of you trespassing on their territory.
Missions_en|188630042728574978: On the mini-map you will see the location of the mini-bosses. They promised to behave peacefully until the Undead start storming your settlement. Try to get rid of them before the main enemy forces approach.
Missions_en|188630042728574977: Kill it before it's too late!
Missions_en|188640771191975936: Welcome to the Rusted Wastelands, my Lord. These lands are ruled by the Nightmare Generals. I highly recommend you get rid of them, and quickly. If even one General leads an assault on our castle, it is better not to resist, but to drink poison immediately.
Missions_en|188630042728574980: The Undead have their own ways and customs. Tradition says they prefer to attack at night. On the other hand, that's what traditions are for, to break them...
Missions_en|188630042728574979: They mostly come at night. Mostly.
Missions_en|268036396446232576:
In the challenges of this section you don't need to build anything, and neither disease or famine threatens your citizens. It's quite simple: just manage your army and defend the Obelisk.
But hey, is it really that easy?
Missions_en|268036396450426881: The rebellious peasants want to take you by the numbers (once again). What they don't realize is that they are about to walk into an ambush! There are all sorts of traps and towers around your positions. The key is to take up defensive lines before the attack begins.
Missions_en|273800775871606784:
My Lord, I have fabulous news! You don't have to worry about population growth, or disease, or hunger! You won't have to build anything either. But that's fine, as everything we need has already been built for us.

The bad news is that we will be attacked and they will try to break our <#ABA291>Astonishing obelisk.
But just to end on a bright note, I'll cheer you up. We have enough troops to repel the attack.
Missions_en|274493083621371904: The King, the Undead and the Rebels have formed an alliance against you. How exactly they line-up and in what order your enemies will come against you is a surprise. Your troops have set up several camps and prepared defensive lines. You have three attacks to counter on a large map covered in scenic swamps.
Missions_en|274493083621371905:
My Lord, I have tremendous news! You don't need to worry about population growth, or disease, or hunger! You don't even have to build anything... Well, you can't, because there are no builders either...

The bad news is that we will be attacked, thrice. All for the sake of breaking down our <#ABA291>Astonishing obelisk.
But let me end on a high note. As you can see, your army corps have already taken several defensive lines.
Missions_en|274493083621371907:
In this challenge you have only Swordsmen in your army.
North East and South West to your position there are Barracks, where you can hire even more Swordsmen.
However, there is a serious risk that fallen troops will rise from the dead and want to avenge their deaths on you.
Missions_en|274493083621371908:
My Lord, I have exciting news! You don't have to worry, not about disease, not about hunger! You have an army... of some sort... Also, you have Barracks and a whole crowd eager to become Swordsmen.

Unfortunately, My Lord, the Undead do not mind adding your Swordsmen to their numbers. Enemies are bent on destroying our <#ABA291>Astonishing obelisk.
Still, I trust your strategic genius will prevail over the army of darkness.
Missions_en|375693617476251648: This section contains challenges with a city already built for you, and the game's functionality is partially restricted. However, the provided arsenal should be enough for you to protect your people from the cruel discriminatory behavior of your neighbors. The game sessions here are as short as possible.
Missions_en|375693617476251650:
The walls of your city are strong. And the economy is flourishing. But is that enough to beat off the assault of a crowd of enemies who envy your good fortune?
Building fortifications is disabled. To win a battle, you'll have to use all available resources, including magic and starting army.
Missions_en|375693617476251651: My Lord, a dark thing has happened! The Southerners, who used to do nothing but herd pigs, harvest crops, and celebrate their harvest on a grand scale, have suddenly sobered up and realized that we Northerners live by trade. They also noticed that we live a much better life than they do. They decided that if they attacked and plundered your magnificent city, they would live well too. The good news is we have a regular, disciplined army on our side. The bad news is we're outnumbered. I suppose if we move troops on the defenses between the flanks in time and make sure the city gates are closed at the moment of attack, we can win. I should also note that some of our warriors are not under the protection of the city walls right now. They better be kept safe, for in battles like these casualties could lead to fatal consequences.
Missions_en|375693617476251653: The entire population of the village is at your command. You need to train enough soldiers to give a decisive response to the aggressors. Lucky for you, the village is on the edge of the countryside. The only way to the Townhall is through a narrow canyon.
Missions_en|375693617476251654:
My Lord, alarm!

At a rustic wedding where the bride was your loyal subject and the groom was from a neighboring settlement, they tried to serve goat hooves stew as the main course! And in place of what? In place of our festive frog leg soup!

A brawl started, in which the groom was hit on the head by the bride with a rolling pin. Now, the neighboring peasants are on their way to raze our beloved village.

Many of your people have already fallen at the wedding. We're outnumbered. We can only hope that by setting traps and turning regular citizens into trained warriors, it'll become possible to fight back the crowd of culinary perverts.
Missions_en|375693617476251655: My Lord, reinforcements arrived. The survivors from the bloody wedding are here. They're all ready to join the army, but they don't know which military branch to join. If you guide them, we'll have a better chance of repelling the assault.
Missions_en|499625033919217670: This section contains challenges of increased difficulty. The battle to come will be insanely epic. You have to repel a single, yet incredibly powerful attack. However, the chance to win remains as at the start you are given enough resources.
Missions_en|499625033919217672:
You gained a position of Samreignian King four and a half months ago.
It may be a dream job for somebody. But not for somebody like you.
You became tired of the monotonous feasts and signing decrees, signing decrees and high-level meetings pretty fast. “Why not take a trip to another continent and conquer it?” you thought to yourself.
Missions_en|501759944514449408:
Your Grace! The entire continent has fallen at your feet. Through your Grace's military and diplomatic genius, Samreignia has expanded to become the largest state on both sides of the Halimatyan Sea!

However, I must say that the other countries are not willing to acknowledge the annexation as long as there is fighting in the newly acquired territories.

Which brings us to the second point: Sarranga, the tribe that once inhabited these lands, has decided to take the suicidal step of attacking our positions. Simply put, we are one step away from recognizing our territorial gains. What we need to do is win one last battle.
Missions_en|499625033919217674:
Once upon a time you managed to achieve an incredible thing. You've driven the Undead from their lands.
But the main problem with the Undead is that they cannot be killed permanently.
So, exiled and angry, they have decided to take your lands in exchange for the lost ones.
Try to reason with them. In a way...
Missions_en|501759944552198144:
Ah, crap! I was counting on us, My Lord, to meet next time in some DLC. But the devs have decided to give players some new maps for the Challenge mode.

Well, as you realize, I'm not really afraid of death. I'm no stranger to killing you either.

Anyways, in a few in-game days, my army will come for you. And it's going to wreak death. And there's nothing you can do about it.

Muah-hah-hah-haaaa!
Missions_en|499625033919217676:
You were the hope of the Resistance in the people's war against the tyranny of Ferdinand II of Samreignia.
Yet you fell in love with Shankhar, a princess of the Sarranga tribe, with whom you escaped from fighting.
Now the Rebellious Peasants, having been defeated by the Royal Army, want to “thank” you for your betrayal.
Missions_en|501759944552198145:
Meelove! I know always that stop fighting is right. But somehow the plough people you rule before not agree.

Good that Sarranga are friends. Also good that they don't mind fight.

Disgust, but you have to hire warriors or your ex-friends kill me. Then they kill you. And they hurt other Sarranga badly too.
Missions_en|499625033919217678:
When you stormed the capital of Samreignia, Baron Slowcoach got lost in the swamps and could not come to the rescue of his king.
5 years later, he finally found his way. Now, he's eager to give you a decisive battle.
Missions_en|501759944552198146:
My Lord today, I have exciting news! Remember when I was auditing the powerful siege machines known as Terminator machines on Samreignia's balance sheet, I found a few missing?

Well, I've traced them, My Lord. They appear to be assigned to the Baron Slowcoach's army.

However, the question still remains how to get these machines back into our possession, as the Baron hopes to capture our castle using them against us...
Missions_en|540470052645093376: To complete challenges of this section you need to detect and destroy strategically important objects of your enemy (that's right, you'll have to attack them). Of course, your enemies don't sleep. You can expect constant counterattacks in return, until the mission objectives are accomplished.
Missions_en|540470052645093380: Archilich Korador, not-alive after meeting giant crabs but still kicking, finally landed with his army on the coast of Samreignia. In the role of Lord Hareheart, you must introduce the Undeads with the famous Rothglenian hospitality and sink Korador's flagship.
Missions_en|540470052645093381:
Here comes Archlich Korador, the Chosen Bearer of the Song! I am holding the first Bloodstock-1491 open air fest in the history of Samreignia. Mere mortals, tonight rock will sound from every house!

We've already assembled the stage, come to the Flagship to die and join the Undead!

Resistance is futile, for my coming was foretold in the Prophecy! You are all doomed!

LET'S ROCK!
Missions_en|540470052645093384: One of the founders of the East Sarranga Company, you are greatly worried about the magical bound between Sarranga and Bugs. To be more precise, you're concerned about bugs infesting your coffee plantations. In order for the disinfestation to be effective, the Forsaken Obelisk must be broken. The Sarranga tribe, however, are unlikely to be thrilled with this concept.
Missions_en|540470052645093385:
Dear Partner! Our company certainly respects and honors the traditions of the indigenous people of the Uncharted Continent. However, all respect comes to an end when foolish superstitions cause us to lose money.

In this case, we don't like the Sarranga's stupid connection to the cursed giant cockroaches that significantly reduce the yield of coffee plantations. As our deep-cover agents have determined, it's the Forsaken Obelisk that provides the spiritual сonnection.

Your mission is to destroy the Obelisk. Agents warn you that disgruntled natives may attempt to jeopardize the mission. As Chief Security Officer you're authorized to “pacify” them by any means necessary.
Missions_en|540470052645093388: After the Resistance defeated Ferdinand II, Baron Spencer, head of the Shoehorn Corporation, flatly refused to pay taxes to the Elected Ruler of Samreignia. Moreover, the Baron dared to threaten that his company had enough resources to take over the government. It should be explained to him in a clear manner that he had made a big miscalculation.
Missions_en|540470052645093389:
Greetings, responsible citizen of free Samreignia. It's me, your legally elected ruler.

Our ever-so-helpful scouts report that there are secret laboratories of Baron Spencer's Shoehorn Corporation not far from your position. It is absolutely necessary for you destroy all 3 of them. There is an intel that the Baron is conducting some dangerous experiments in his labs, potentially threatening our statehood.

Samreignia counts on you. Don't let me down!
Missions_en|540470052649287680:
Responsible citizen of Samreignia, we have a problem that you are going to solve. Shoehorn security has been alerted. It appears, Baron is planning a preemptive strike. On you.

In case you don't survive the attack, I'll have you given a hero's burial. With the highest honors.
Missions_en|540470052649287681:
Once again, the fate of the country depends on your strategical talents, my dear responsible citizen. We have a bird's-eye view of new Shoehorn security activity. You will be tested again. And it's going to be a tougher test to pass.

In case you were wondering how I get a bird's eye view of the war zone from my government residence in Abberlore, the answer is "Magic".
Missions_en|540470052649287682:
I've just received a shot of the destroyed Shoehorn lab on my personal Palpantir - that's the kind of magical transparent pyramid that shows me what's happening on the battlefield.

I knew you'd fulfill your civic duty. Congratulations. Now, if anything happens to you, I'll bury you in a government cemetery. Somewhere out of sight.

But you better make sure it doesn't come to that. Besides, the second lab is still in operation. However, I have no doubt that you will fix this soon.
Missions_en|540470052649287683:
Congratulations, you've destroyed the central labor... What the hell is going on in there?

I have no idea what Baron Spencer was experimenting on, but that thing that escaped from the central lab has to be killed.

And since I don't have a bird's-eye view of any other candidates for the mission, you're in charge.
Missions_en|540470052649287685: Destroy everything related to the Monstrous Experiment
Missions_en|540470052645093378: How hard can it be to repel 3 pathetic attacks? Well, see for yourself when your defense is under constant pressure. The enemy will regularly attack you in small but extremely annoying groups.
Missions_en|540470052649287687: In a land of lakes and rivers, there are buildings from which Sarranga warriors of all imaginable types regularly appear. And then they go straight to your Townhall.
Missions_en|540470052649287688:
My Lord, your spontaneous decision yesterday to invite the daughter of the Sarranga chief to dinner before the traditional exchange of basalt figurines has caused unforseen consequences.

To clarify, Sarranga do not consider your diplomatic immunity a sufficient reason not to put you on the anthill.

All that would be fine, but our castle still having the ambassadorial status, is geographically on tribal land.

Which means we're outnumbered and surrounded.
Missions_en|540470052649287689:
My lord, our vigilant scouts report that Sarranga decided to use their Scorpios in battle.

Although these same scouts have previously stated that the enemy has no siege weapons. The situation is complicated by the fact that the report does not say how many Scorpios the enemy has thrown at us.

If I were you, I would think about either changing the scouts or somehow professionalizing them.
Missions_en|540470052649287691: Welcome to the Rusty Tops. A blighted place where the Undead are produced on an industrial scale.
Missions_en|540470052649287692:
My Lord, today you and I are true infiltrators, having gotten deep into the enemy territory and built a Townhall there. But there's something we didn't take into account. Namely, that in its deep rear, enemy concentrated serious production facilities. So, all that they produce will be thrown at us.

There is only one reason for optimism: the enemy is hardly able to move the main army in the deep rear. Relying on no data, I forecast that, aside from the Undead produced nearby, we will have to repel only three powerful attacks.
Missions_en|540470052649287693:
My Lord, your fortitude and courage didn't come unnoticed by the enemy. And now, in an effort to counter them, the Undead have ramped up their production capacity to the point where they are producing Grim Pilgrims and Magisters of Necromancy right under our noses.

I suppose such a change in the enemy's line up might not be good for our defenses.
Missions_en|540470052653481985: Once canceled in one of the Campaign missions, the Rothglen Beer Fest is back in business. Now you can get the rare pleasure of scattering crowds of drunken unshaven ragamuffins threatening to empty your beer cellar.
Missions_en|540470052653481986:
My Lord, to the West the largest annual beer festival in all of Samreignia started. I would suggest you to participate in it yourself, for it is a large and momentous event. But I'm afraid we have other concerns.

In fact, when the festival is over, a drunken and obsessed crowd goes to the nearest castle to empty its cellars. Your cellars, My Lord, to be precise.

So, like last year, instead of celebrating, we'll be preparing our defenses.
Missions_en|540470052653481987:
My Lord, the wind blows from the West. And I'm getting tipsy just breathing the air. It is a sure sign that the first and most impatient spectators are coming from the fest.

I want to believe that this time everything will turn out better than six years ago, when your castle had to be rebuilt anew...
Missions_en|256108571392847872: A reimagining of the battle against Scott the Bloody. Play your own alternate history.
Missions_en|256108571422208000: A reimagining of the battle between Rebels and Royal vanguard. Play your own alternate history.
Missions_en|256108571422208001:
In Endless mode, one of the problems on this map was the number of enemy camps.
In Sandbox mode, you can turn them off.
But should you?
Missions_en|256108571422208002:
On this very map, in Endless mode you fought against Royal army. What if the Undead join them? Or Rebels?
Go beyond your imagination!
Missions_en|256108571422208003: Thanks to many gorges and mountains, you can make the frontline narrow to counterbalance the enemy's numerical superiority.
Missions_en|256108571422208004: You will have to combat in rugged terrain, criss-crossed by lakes and rivers. Barracks III are given at the start, located at a distance from the Townhall.
Missions_en|256108571422208005: The smallest map. In Challenge mode, it was also the easiest. But in Sandbox mode, you can fix that.
Missions_en|256108571422208006: In Challenge mode on this map, you fought against the Undead. Somehow we think this provides a field for experiments like "what would happen if the Undead teamed up with...".
Missions_en|256108571422208007: At the start you are given Townhall III, lots of Storages, Granaries and Houses. Here, you'll build your settlement much faster.
Missions_en|268072252586438657: There is a ravine to the north of your Town Hall. This is exactly the point you must secure. There is a chance that the enemy may find a way to your domain from the East and West, but not from the South, certainly.
Missions_en|268072252586438659: In the North-East corner of the ring is your castle, surrounded by mountains on three sides. In the Southwest corner of the ring are the Nightmare Generals in their glory. This map is too small for all of you.
Missions_en|268072252586438661: A map that doesn't really have anything to impress itself apart from its spectacular size.
Missions_en|268072252594827264: The large map, riddled with cliffs and mountains, provides maximum scope for your imagination as well as allowing you to sharpen your tactical and strategic skills against the Undead.
Missions_en|268072252594827266: Your castle stands on the seashore, in an exclusive spot in the South West of a huge area. The problem is that it's the only beach nearby. There will be someone willing to drive you out of there...
Missions_en|268072252594827268: The only source of water on this map is the river originating from the Whale Mountain. Speaking of which: it's out there and you won't find any other mountains. Townhall II is given at the start.
Missions_en|268072252594827267: Plains are meant to be battlefields
Missions_en|392684949637804032: In the corner of the map, there's your settlement with Townhall II and already built fortifications. There is plenty of space for resources in Storage. Enemies may get to you from the East and South.
Missions_en|392684949637804034: At start you are given a settlement with Town Hall III. The only approach to your position is through a narrow canyon. Which means: The Enemy will come from the East.
Missions_en|403571385782087680: Think of a way to defeat the united forces of the Rebels, the Royal Army and the Undead.

My Lord, I found a relevant quote:

My Lord, a bit of wisdom from your grandfather, fitting for the occasion: “If you’ve done everything @#$%'n right, you can take a swig from your rum flask and rejoice while your dumb enemies drop dead one by one.”

Tutorial_en|651781168348258305:
Brother in arms! The sneaky bastards of the criminal regime have failed to break us! We are still standing!

Our vigilant scouts report: the filthy foul scoundrels from the royal patrol will continue their pathetic assault.

But you and I know: with every attack they're one step closer to the unequivocal victory for the Resistance!

Tutorial_en|19068961268584448:
The more <#ABA291>Builders' houses you have, the faster you will finish construction works. Moreover, there are two <#ABA291>Builders at the <#ABA291>Townhall.

You can also <#ABA291>set the working radius for your workers, including Builders. They will perform their work within the specified area.
Tutorial_en|110825318072037377: Every morning <#ABA291>new people</color> come to your settlement if there is room for them. Build a couple of <#ABA291>Houses</color>.
Tutorial_en|1376183621406720: <#ABA291>Avoid building side-by-side</color>, especially for those buildings that require a worker. Leave at least one tile of free space for your <#ABA291>workers to access the buildings</color>.
Tutorial_en|19069431408119808:
<#ABA291>Builders also <#ABA291>repair buildings.
Press the <#ABA291>auto-repair button [\] for them to do this automatically. Resources for repairs will also be written off automatically.
Tutorial_en|19069480120766464: <#ABA291>Research</color> allows you to improve the economic and military life of your settlement. Some research gets unlocked after you construct or improve certain buildings. Open the <#ABA291>research window</color> and start any available research.
Tutorial_en|19069506637156352: A <#ABA291>disease</color> has begun to spread in your settlement. To deal with it build a <#ABA291>First aid tent</color>. Within its range citizens are cured of all the diseases.
Tutorial_en|598668103680:
Scroll the <#ABA291>mousewheel to <#ABA291>zoom in or out the camera.
By default, you can also use <#ABA291>[-] (Num) and <#ABA291>[+] (Num).
Tutorial_en|65086675331522560: Some enemy buildings will spawn more enemies. If you highlight an enemy building, you can see under what conditions this will happen.
Tutorial_en|651090753454333953: You should destroy enemy buildings to prevent the enemy from receiving reinforcements. This will also allow you to expand your territory for the future development of your settlement.
Tutorial_en|19068178007478272: Soul crystals are the resource to cast spells. They appear in the place of most of enemy buildings you've destroyed. Your troops can collect Soul Crystals, providing you with the opportunity to cast more spells.
Tutorial_en|651090753454333956: There are often Carts scattered across the Map that contain various resources. Your troops can collect them too. Remember that you can't get more resources than your Storage can hold.
Tutorial_en|19071681786433536: In Diplomacy is Not an Option the enemy will attack you in <#ABA291>waves</color>. Usually you have to repel several attacking waves to win. You can see on the <#ABA291>minimap</color> where the nearest wave of enemies will come from.
Tutorial_en|110825318084620288: You need to raise your military strength to deal with superior enemy forces. Build <#ABA291>Barracks</color> and hire <#ABA291>archers</color> in it.
Tutorial_en|19071761490792448: Build <#ABA291>defensive structures</color> on the way of the approaching enemy.
Tutorial_en|651090753454333952: Switch the attack mode of the ranged units placed on a single Tower to <#ABA291>Attack the strongest target</color>.
Tutorial_en|19071866662965248: Archers placed on <#ABA291>Walls</color>, <#ABA291>Towers</color> or <#ABA291>Gates</color> are protected from enemy melee attacks. In addition, this increases their firing range. It works for all your ranged troops. Also archers may hit the target while standing behind the wall.
Tutorial_en|19071965312995328: You can also use <#ABA291>magic</color>. Without the <#ABA291>Obelisk</color> you can cast only the <#ABA291>Summon</color> spell.
Tutorial_en|689151823872:
Ноld the <#ABA291>mousewheel and move your mouse to <#ABA291>rotate the camera.
You can also use <#ABA291>[Q] and <#ABA291>[E] for rotation and <#ABA291>[PgUp] and <#ABA291>[PgDn] for tilt.
Tutorial_en|805099163648: <#ABA291>Townhall</color> is the main building of your settlement. Once it is destroyed you will immediately lose the game. <#ABA291>Select</color> the Townhall by clicking <#ABA291>LMB</color>.
Tutorial_en|1374853246898176:
To control your <#ABA291>troops you need to select them. Select several <#ABA291>Swordsmen or <#ABA291>Archers by pressing <#ABA291>LMB and dragging the <#ABA291>selection box around them.

You can also select all the troops on the screen by pressing <#ABA291>~. If you quickly press <#ABA291>~ twice, you will select all the troops you have.
Tutorial_en|651090753429168128:
Press <#ABA291>[ALT] to display troops' <#ABA291>healthbars and other useful information.

For example, you'll see <#ABA291>enemy healthbars, allowing you to track the enemy's movement even when they're hidden behind trees or other obstacles.
Tutorial_en|1375284027084800:
To arms! Click <#ABA291>RMB to order selected troops to <#ABA291>Move or <#ABA291>Attack the enemy.

You can also use the <#ABA291>Attack and Move order (press the <#ABA291>“F” key, then click <#ABA291>LMB to set the point where the selected troops will move).

Your troops will attack nearby enemies automatically, unless given a different order.
Tutorial_en|651090753433362434: Every day your <#ABA291>citizens</color> and <#ABA291>troops</color> consume food. To avoid famine you're going to need <#ABA291>food</color> production. <#ABA291>Berry picker's house</color> will do.
Tutorial_en|1375290356289536: <#ABA291>Fishermen's hut</color> provides your settlement with <#ABA291>food</color> too. However, fish is a finite, non-replenishable resource. When there are no schools of fish left in the body of water, Fishermen stop food production.
Tutorial_en|19068114669293568: You need <#ABA291>wood</color> for construction. To get it, build a <#ABA291>Lumbermill</color>.

UI_en|672902255156912128: Use the Pause when you need a moment to think about your next move. But when nothing on the screen requires your attention, feel free to Increase game speed.
UI_en|672902255156912130: There are several ways to select multiple objects. Pressing “~” will select all troops on the screen. A quick double-tap of “~” will select all your troops. By double-clicking LMB on an object, you can select all objects of the same type (such as buildings or troops).
UI_en|672902255161106433: Toggle “Auto-Repair” on for workers to repair damaged buildings on their own. You can also enable this feature separately for each selected building.
UI_en|672902255161106435: Unlike your troops, citizens can get infected. When this happens, they move slower and may infect others or even die. First aid tents and Hospitals treat all infected people within their action areas.
UI_en|672902255161106437: The bodies of fallen troops and citizens will spread disease, and eventually, the bodies will turn into zombies. That is why the dead must be buried. To do this, you need a Gravediggers' house with workers and a Cemetery with burial space.
UI_en|672902255161106439: You can deploy war machines and ranged troops on fortifications. War machines require more space to deploy than Archers or Crossbowmen.
UI_en|672902255161106441: You can deploy ranged troops on rooftops of Townhall and some Barracks.
UI_en|672902255161106440: Deployment of troops on building rooftops
UI_en|672902255161106443: Use this button to immediately pull out all troops from the fortification or rooftop they were deployed on. You can send troops down separately by selecting them in the interface and clicking LMB on the ground. Troops will appear on the ground on the side closest to the exit point you specified.
UI_en|672902255161106445: The resource reserve is replenished when a worker brings a resource they have extracted to the Townhall or Storage. The closer the Storage is to the building where the resource is extracted, the less time the worker spends walking and the faster the resource reserve is replenished.
UI_en|672902255161106447: Food reserves are replenished when a worker brings food to the Townhall or Granaries. The closer the Granary is to the building that produces food, the less time the worker will spend walking and the faster your reserves will be replenished.
UI_en|672902255161106449: The more Builders you have involved in the construction of a building, the faster they will complete the work. Assign as many Builders as possible (until you reach the limit) to accelerate mass construction.
UI_en|672902255169495041: Each extraction building has an action area within which assigned workers extract the corresponding resource. You can change the action area by moving the flag for your workers to locate the resource in a new area. Alternatively, you can demolish the extraction building and construct a new one closer to the resource source.
UI_en|672902255169495042: Builders' Houses have an action area within which Builders can perform their tasks. You can change the action area by moving the flag, or increase its radius for the planned construction site to be within the action area. You can also place a new Builders' house closer to the planned construction site.
UI_en|672902255169495045: The amount of each resource that can be extracted at its source is limited. The higher the level of the extraction building, the more of that resource you can possibly extract from the source.
UI_en|672902255169495047: Research affects many aspects of the game, from unlocking new skills for your troops to economic improvements. Switching to a different mission resets your research progress, so you’ll have to start over. Different research may come in handy depending on the game situation.
UI_en|672902255169495049: The higher the level of an extraction building, the faster the assigned workers extract resources, and the larger the resource reserve in the source.
UI_en|672902255169495051: Foresters plant trees, creating a source of wood. Without them, you’ll eventually cut down all the forests and face a shortage of building materials.
UI_en|672902255169495053: Stone ore fields are an infinite source of stone. To extract stone from them, you need to build Stone works. Stone works built on stone ore fields of any size will endlessly produce stone.
UI_en|672902255169495055: Iron ore fields are an infinite source of iron located on water. To extract Iron from them, you need to build Iron works. Iron works built on iron ore fields of any size will endlessly produce iron.
UI_en|672902255169495057: The Alchemical Transgressor is an infinite source of Soul Crystals. You can only build it on Blue glowing rifts on the ground. There can be only one Alchemical Transgressor in the entire settlement.
UI_en|672902255169495059: The more Houses you build, the more citizens arrive in your settlement each morning, thereby increasing its population.
UI_en|672902255169495061: You can create Zombies are from fallen enemies using the ability of Twilight Overlord’s Avatar. You can also produce Zombies in Barrows. Zombies can be useful as a defensive line, holding back enemy forces. You can process Zombies into Bones at the Citadel of the Undead.
UI_en|672902255177883648: Dark Energy powers your undead warriors. No troop can exist without it, except for Zombies and the Overlord's Avatar. It is the Dark Energy limit that defines the maximum size of your army. The limit can be increased by building Dark Generators.
